jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - PMO (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Technical Project Manager (all genders) to join our PMO team as soon as possible. We embrace a remote-first approach (within Germany), but you can choose whether you’d like to work in a hybrid model or entirely on-site, depending on your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Hamburg, Cologne, Munich).


As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you are a cornerstone of strategy execution at Contabo – and you're joining at a time when a lot is moving strategically. Alongside the continued evolution of our existing cloud infrastructure, we are driving initiatives that will expand our portfolio well beyond what exists today over the coming years. This is exactly where your role comes in: embedded in our PMO, you take end-to-end ownership of technical projects across development teams and business functions – including initiatives for which no blueprint exists yet, where you help shape structures from the ground up.

You work at the intersection of technology and business: you translate sometimes still ambiguous requirements into executable plans, actively challenge requirements, and structure initiatives into scalable roadmaps, iterations, and implementation phases. In your day-to-day work, you coordinate priorities, dependencies, and delivery sequencing across multiple teams and parallel workstreams, identify resource bottlenecks and delivery risks early, and ensure transparency through structured reporting, clear governance, and effective escalation management – especially when scope and priorities shift in our fast-moving environment. You'll be working with tools like Jira, Confluence, and comparable solutions.

Beyond individual projects, you shape the PMO itself: you continuously develop our standards and processes, support portfolio alignment and prioritisation, and share your knowledge as a mentor to junior project managers. A lean PMO at Contabo means a high degree of autonomy and genuine ownership – you report directly to the Head of Strategy Execution & ESG and contribute measurably to the execution of Contabo's strategic roadmap.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project or program management within software development or technical delivery organisations
  • Proven end-to-end delivery ownership of cross-functional initiatives with multiple parallel workstreams – not limited to governance or status-reporting roles
  • Strong experience in stakeholder and escalation management
  • A high degree of ownership and composure in an environment of shifting priorities and ambiguity
  • Confident use of common PM tooling such as Jira, Confluence (or comparable)
  • Experience in a cloud, hosting, or IT infrastructure environment, as well as with agile scaling, PMO, or portfolio management (a plus)
  • A completed degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable qualification
  • Professional fluency in English; German language skills and certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, PSM) are a plus

We know that you may not currently meet all of these requirements. But if you bring the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm for the role, we can achieve great things together.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.

What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
  • Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
  • Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
  • Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
  • Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
  • Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
  • Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
  • Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
  • Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
  • Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
  • Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget


How to reach us

If you have any questions, you can reach out to Max by email at .

Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Senior Cloud Product Manager (all genders) to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first (within Germany), but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).


As a Senior Cloud Product Manager at Contabo, you're stepping into a role that doesn't come around often: you help build a new product from the ground up – a greenfield venture inside an established company, expanding our portfolio into a new market segment. You are the voice of the market and our customers: you establish feedback channels with customer and support teams, translate market and customer needs into a compelling product vision, and take end-to-end ownership of the product roadmap – from high-level planning through prioritisation to delivery, in close alignment with our PMO.

jobs.description:

Déployer l'IA et les solutions digitales de pointe à grande échelle, avec une culture de l’excellence forgée sur le plateau de Paris-Saclay.

Notre force repose sur une double approche unique :

Propulsés par une croissance ultra-dynamique (15 M€ de CA en 2025 et une récente levée de fonds), nous structurons notre département Delivery. Nous recherchons un(e) leader capable d'allier rigueur opérationnelle et excellence technologique.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (ISR) Defence & Intelligence (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager (ISR) (f/m/x) to own the product and delivery side of LiveEO's defence and intelligence business. Sektion 4 builds AI-based ISR capabilities for German and allied defence and intelligence customers: object and change detection in very high resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain products derived from stereo imagery, and the analytics that turn imagery into decisions. You will run our customer-facing defence products end to end from a product management perspective including analytical products as well as end user applications. You will also build the roadmap that connects different customer timelines, our concept of operations and the actual maturity of our technical components into one plan that engineering and sales both work from. This role exists because our LiveEO engineers build world class AI models and your work will help to bring them into operations and roll them out to many more end users. We need someone who can say how an analyst does the job, write requirements a military user would recognise, and hold the line on what we ship.

LiveEO is a dynamic team that thrives on big challenges and fast learning cycles. We move quickly, stay curious, and genuinely enjoy building together. We are on a mission to break the "curse of Earth Observation": turning incredible satellite data into reliable, actionable decisions that people can trust and use in real operations on scale. 

You will be part of Sektion 4, LiveEO's government-solutions product team. Sektion 4 owns its roadmap and delivers funded R&D projects and defence engagements end-to-end, from research through to production, and sets its own technical direction. You will work day to day with the team's ML engineergs, full-stack engineers and geospatial data egineers, and across LiveEO with sales, pre-sales and the teams building the Twinspector satellite programme. Externally you are in front of military and agency users, partners and integrators, in workshops, requirement sessions and user tests.


Tech stack & tools:
  • Linear (backlog, sprints)
  • Confluence
  • Google Workspace 
  • LiveEO's own ISR and analytics applications
  • Figma 
  • QGIS and comparable viewers
  • STAC-based imagery catalogs Data:
  • very high resolution optical imagery
  • synthetic aperture radar
  • 3D surface models 
  • cloud and secure on-premise / air-gapped deployments
  • agentic tools for a variety of work.


Your challenge

As Product Manager (f/m/x), you own what we build for defence and intelligence customers, and you are accountable for it reaching them.

  • Own the ISR product: take our imagery intelligence application from working demonstrator to deployable product. Define the release scope, the deployment and support model for secure on-premise environments, and drive the first installation at a real user.

  • Run the backlog: work with the engineering team in two-week sprints. Translate operational needs into written requirements and user stories, prioritise ruthlessly, cut scope when it is the right call, and keep the team pointed at what matters.

  • Deliver defence projects end to end: own scope, milestones, deliverables and stakeholder communication for our customer-facing defence engagements, and take on new projects as the pipeline converts.

  • Build and maintain the roadmap: reconcile project timelines, our concept of operations and component readiness into one roadmap that is used to set priorities, not to describe them afterwards.

  • Be the ISR authority in the team: bring operational depth on the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and imagery exploitation. Be the person engineering asks how an analyst would really use this, and the person sales asks what we can credibly claim.

  • Work with users and customers: run workshops and user sessions, gather and structure feedback, demonstrate the product, and support bids and proposals with operational substance.


Your profile

  • Professional ISR, GEOINT or IMINT background: Bundeswehr, the intelligence community, defence procurement, or an ISR role in industry.

  • Real operational fluency in the intelligence cycle, collection and tasking, and how imagery products are produced and consumed at a staff.

  • Proven ability to translate operational needs into written requirements that engineers can build from. Track record of driving work to a deadline across dependencies you did not control.

  • German at native or fully fluent level, and professional English.

  • German or European citizenship and eligibility to obtain a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). 

  • Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, hybrid with at least two days per week in the office, and to travel within Germany to customers and users.

  • You take ownership and proactively push work forward. 

  • You communicate clearly and collaborate smoothly within and across teams.

  • Pragmatic mindset: you balance operational ambition with what can actually be shipped.

  • You enjoy working with complexity and turning ambiguity into structure.

  • Product management or product ownership experience: backlog, sprint cadence, release scoping is a plus.

  • Project management experience in defence or publicly funded programmes (national, EU, NATO) is a plus.

  • Experience writing CONOPS, operational requirements or capability documents is a plus.

  • Familiarity with satellite imagery, remote sensing, or AI and machine learning products is a plus.

  • Experience delivering software into secure on-premise or air-gapped environments is a plus.

  • An existing valid German security clearance (SÜ2 / SÜ3) is a plus.

  • Working knowledge of NATO standards and interoperability for imagery and geospatial data is a plus.


Your Benefits

  • The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work model - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

  • We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.

  • Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.

  • A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons.

  • Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.

  • Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.

  • Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, corporate pension program.

  • A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities

jobs.title: Strategic Project Manager
jobs.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 
 

Why this role exists

Pennylane is one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, building the financial operating system for SMBs and their accountants. Growth at our pace creates a constant stream of high-stakes, cross-functional initiatives that don't sit neatly inside any one team such as entering new markets, redesigning pricing, launching e-invoicing ahead of regulation.

This role owns those initiatives. You'll work directly with the VP Strategic Initiatives (and, through him, the executive committee) to take our most important initiatives from a blank page to a shipped outcome. It's a rare seat: broad exposure to how a scale-up actually makes its biggest decisions, real ownership from day one, and the kind of scope that builds a strong foundation for an operating role over time.

What you'll own

You'll lead selected priority initiatives end-to-end. For each, that means:

  • Framing the problem. Turn an ambiguous executive ambition into a structured plan: the hypothesis, the analysis that tests it, the milestones, and the definition of success.

  • Driving the work. Coordinate the product, commercial, finance, and ops teams needed to deliver. You're the person who makes sure it actually ships, on time and to the bar.

  • Doing the analysis yourself. Build the models, pull the data, and pressure-test the numbers that decisions rest on. You won't delegate the thinking.

  • Keeping the ExCo close. Report progress, risks, and recommendations crisply and often. When something is off track, they hear it from you first, with a proposed path forward.

Some initiatives you'll run start to finish. On others you'll be the extra set of hands on whatever matters most that quarter. Both require someone who's comfortable being handed a hard, undefined problem and trusted to figure it out.

Who we're looking for

Working closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, development teams and global UX colleagues at FE fundinfo, you’ll have a visible impact on both the customer experience and Dericon’s visual identity.

Your key responsibilities as a Product Designer will include:

  • Creating wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes and intuitive interfaces that balance user needs, business requirements and technical feasibility.
  • Planning and conducting user research, including interviews, usability testing, surveys and discovery sessions, and translating findings into actionable design insights.
  • Building and maintaining design libraries, reusable components, patterns and guidelines to create a consistent experience across Dericon’s digital products.
  • Iterating on designs using user feedback, usability testing, stakeholder input and data insights to continuously improve product experiences.
  • Partnering with Product Owners, Engineering, business stakeholders and global UX colleagues to align designs with product roadmaps and ensure effective implementation.
  • Supporting a modern, consistent and customer-focused brand experience across digital and physical touchpoints while considering accessibility and inclusive design principles.

You will need the following experience and skills to join us as a Product Designer:

  • You will have experience in UX research, UX design or a hybrid research and design role, with a strong portfolio demonstrating your approach and impact.
  • You will have hands-on experience conducting user research and translating findings into effective design solutions.
  • You will have strong proficiency in Figma, Sketch or similar design tools, with the ability to create high-quality wireframes, prototypes and user flows.
  • You will have experience building or contributing to design systems and component libraries, with a strong understanding of consistency and reusable design patterns.
  • You will be a confident communicator who can collaborate effectively with stakeholders and development teams, work independently and take ownership in an Agile environment.

FE fundinfo is a leading financial data provider, connecting the investment industry across the UK, Europe, and Asia-Pacific through an integrated platform. Our skilled team empowers clients with data-driven insights, making the industry Navigate Complexity with Confidence!

You’ll join a collaborative and international environment where design, product and engineering teams work closely together across geographies. The role offers the opportunity to contribute to meaningful fintech products, exchange knowledge with global UX colleagues and make a tangible impact on the way financial services professionals interact with digital solutions. jobs.title: Product Manager (parental leave cover)
jobs.description:
About Tandem

Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem.


We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures.


We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members. 


Your role will be to:

  • Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests.

  • Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas.

  • Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket.

  • Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on.


You are the right fit for the role if you:

  • Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale.

  • Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics.

  • Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped.

  • Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English.

  • Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there.

  • Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved.

  • Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations.


The benefits


Passion for languages: 

We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us.


Take a deep dive: 

As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style.


Teams who train together, stay together: 

We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead.


It takes a team to Tandem: 

Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights.


Balance matters: 

Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax.


Modern family: 

As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem.


Relocation without the stress: 

If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time.


Hybrid by design: 

We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Trading
jobs.description:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

The Role:

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager, Rosso.

This is the second product manager on Rosso, reporting into the Rosso Product Lead. Rosso is deeply technical, built on ML-led models and complex engineering covering forecasting, pricing optimisation and portfolio balancing, so this is a role for a technically-minded PM who's happiest closest to the hardest problems. You'll work on complex, important problems as they arise across the Rosso product surface, alongside the other PM on the team, rather than owning one fixed patch. In the near term that means the portfolio area: fulfilling and balancing a growing two-sided portfolio, managing imbalance, and finding the revenue and margin in every position we hold. It's still forming, it carries live financial risk, and it needs someone who wants to win in it.

You will:

  • Take business and customer needs and turn them into feasible, shipped product, working closely enough to the ML and forecasting work to make good calls on it.

  • Own the technical-product detail, setting clear success criteria for how well a model or forecast needs to perform, and designing for the edge cases and operational reality of a system carrying live financial risk.

  • Drive open product decisions to a close - yours and the team's - so delivery keeps moving at pace, with a clear Now, Next and Future for the initiatives you own.

🚀 Responsibilities:

Turn needs into shipped product

  • Take business and customer needs and turn them into feasible product execution, balancing them against nascent ML and forecasting innovations that push the frontier of what's possible.

  • Take initiatives from discovery through to regularly released product, with a clear Now, Next and Future for a given area.

  • Drive open product decisions to a close, so work keeps moving.

  • Decide what to formalise, what stays a prototype and what to drop - be the editor and builder, not just the instigator.

Own the technical-product detail

  • Work embedded in full-stack teams that include ML/data science and software engineers, close enough to the models to make good calls.

  • Set clear success criteria for how well a model or forecast needs to perform for the product to work, and design for the edge cases and operational reality of a system that carries live financial risk.

  • Pull and interrogate your own and others' data to influence and inform decisions, and reason about model performance and error as business indicators.

  • Get close to the people who use what you build, from internal commercial teams to generators and businesses externally.

Win in the portfolio

  • Concentrate, in the near term, on the portfolio area while it's still forming, without that becoming a permanent boundary on where you work.

  • Treat hedging, imbalance and trading decisions as product decisions: when to hold a position, when to trade it out, when to reprice to close a gap in the portfolio.

  • Find the tangible and most pressing problems worth solving - such as whether to buy or build a new forecasting capability, or how to ensure Rosso reacts at scale to any event in the system.

  • Chase the commercial outcome, not just the shipped feature - the measure of this role is margin found and risk managed, at pace.

🎯 Requirements:

Must haves

  • A product manager with real product execution behind them: owned at least one complex product area end to end, with a track record of moving real business outcomes, not just shipping features.

  • Commercial drive. You set the pace for yourself and the people around you, push decisions to a close, and go after revenue and margin. You want to win, and it shows in how you work.

  • Experience in or around trading. Energy trading is the ideal, but financial trading, fintech, battery or EV trading all count - you understand positions, hedging and what it means for a system to carry live financial risk.

  • Uses data analysis throughout the product process, to validate ideas, progress work, and measure success.

  • ML-literate: has worked closely enough with ML and data science to make good calls on model-led products, and can reason about model performance and error as business indicators.

  • Built product in a startup, scaleup or other high-growth environment, with high personal ownership of an area.

  • A strong instinct for failure points, edge cases and the operational reality of a live system.

  • AI-native, AI-literate and AI-critical - you know where it helps and where it hurts.

  • A clear, structured communicator, especially in writing.

Bonus points

  • Hands-on energy trading experience - intraday, day-ahead, imbalance or battery optimisation.

  • Experience where forecasting or fulfilling a two-sided marketplace is central to the product.

  • Experience going through a third-party-access and/or international-expansion transition.

  • Experience with regulated industries and data-heavy products.

✨ Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive salary - our current band for this role is £85,000-£93,000 or equivalent in local currency.

  • Stock Options - everyone on the team has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday + public holidays - Swap public holidays for ones that matter most to you. Plus, get an extra day off for your birthday 🎉.

  • Remote & flexible working - We're fully remote with clear core hours, and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Home working & wellbeing budgets:

    • Up to £1,200 / €1,200 annually to upgrade your remote setup (co-working passes, equipment, etc.).

    • Up to £150 / €150 monthly on anything that supports your wellbeing - from therapy to gym memberships to meditation apps.

 

🗣️ Interview Process:

Our processes normally take around 2-3 weeks from first call to offer - please let us know about any adjustments to timelines that may be required.

  1. First call with our Talent Team (30 Mins). This is to understand your experience, motivations, and discuss the role in more detail.

  2. Behaviour Interview with our Product Lead (45 Mins). This is your chance to really understand the role, the expectations, and ensure alignment on ways of working.

  3. Technical Interview with the Team (75 Mins). You’ll meet with potential peers to discuss how you drive product execution, work closely with ML and engineering teams, and think through real product scenarios - built around a real product decision shaped by a model or forecast, so we're testing on proof, not assertion.

  4. Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders (45 Mins). The final session will be with two cross-functional stakeholders, and will explore how your values align with ours, and is designed to be a genuine two-way conversation, your chance to understand what it’s really like to work at tem.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

Compensation: £85K – £93K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Associate Product Owner
jobs.description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we´re looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
You write specs worth acting on.
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
You know what looks good.
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide.
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
You want to be coached hard.
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day.
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
You want the scope to grow.
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.


What you`ll do

Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday.

  • Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
  • Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
  • Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
  • Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
  • Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients

What you'll be scoping over your first year:
  • Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
  • Public REST APIs and MCP servers, so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
  • AI embedded across the product, inside the surfaces people already work in.
  • Workflow automation inside the platform, so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.


Requirements

  • 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
  • Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
  • Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
Nice to have:
  • B2B enterprise SaaS background
  • Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
  • Notion fluency

Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.


How we hire

Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.

  1. Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
  2. Interview with the PM, including a brief introduction to the work sample: a spec, PRD, or decision doc where your reasoning is visible, plus examples of problems you've framed
  3. Interview
  4. Offer: if it clicks, we don't wait around

Unser Mandant entwickelt innovative Decision-Intelligence-Software für datengestützte Entscheidungen und komplexe betriebliche Abläufe. Dafür wird eine leistungsfähige Kerntechnologie aufgebaut, die strukturiertes Wissen, logisches Schlussfolgern (Reasoning), Planung und KI-Komponenten vereint.

Als Senior Product Manager bist du das entscheidende Bindeglied zwischen Marktbedürfnissen, Customer Insights und technischer Umsetzungsstärke. Deine Mission: ein sich schnell entwickelndes, marktorientiertes Produkt abzuliefern, das geschäftlichen Mehrwert, Produktvision und technische Machbarkeit perfekt ausbalanciert. Du steuerst den Produktlebenszyklus von der ersten Idee bis zum Product-Market-Fit und arbeitest dabei funktionsübergreifend mit Softwareentwicklung, Data Science, Vertrieb und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Diese Rolle ist ideal für jemanden, der genau das bereits erfolgreich getan hat: Produkte in einem Startup-Umfeld aufzubauen und zu skalieren.

  • Produktstrategie & Roadmap: Führung der Produktstrategie in Abstimmung mit den Geschäftszielen sowie Übersetzung der Vision in umsetzbare Pläne.

jobs.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Role context

Pennylane operates today around 40k business accounts through a BaaS model. As Financial Services becomes a larger part of Pennylane’s strategy, we are building Pennylane Financial Services and applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licenses.

Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers under our own licensed entity by early 2027, before progressively migrating existing customers. To make this possible, we are building the first line of defense from the ground up across onboarding, transaction monitoring, fraud and risk operations.

As Lead KYB, you will be one of the first operational leaders joining this greenfield setup. Reporting to the Head of FinCrime Operations, you will own the operational execution of KYB/KYC processes for business customers across the payment scope first, and progressively across credit-related activities as the Société de financement scope ramps up.

Your mission will be to build, structure and scale the KYB team, processes and tooling needed to absorb a target volume of ~10,000 onboardings per month at go-live, while ensuring robust AML/CTF compliance, operational efficiency, and a high-quality customer experience.

This is a high-autonomy role with direct exposure to a strategic regulatory project, close collaboration with Product, Compliance and Risk teams, and the opportunity to shape the operating model of a fast-growing fintech serving hundreds of thousands of French SMEs.

Responsibilities

KYB operations & regulatory execution

  • Own the end-to-end operational execution of KYB/KYC workflows for business customers.

  • Ensure proper application of AML/CTF policies defined by Compliance / LoD2, including:

    • customer risk classification,

    • beneficial ownership checks,

    • PEP and sanctions screening,

    • high-risk customer reviews,

    • escalation of sensitive cases within SLA.

  • Review and approve complex or high-risk KYB cases.

  • Ensure continuity of compliance during the transition from the current BaaS model to Pennylane Financial Services’ own operating model.

  • Maintain strong auditability of KYB decisions, including rejection rationales, escalation trails and supporting documentation.

Team build-up & performance management

  • Recruit, onboard, train and manage the KYB analyst team.

  • Define the target team structure, roles, responsibilities and escalation paths.

  • Build the performance framework for the KYB team:

    • SLAs,

    • productivity metrics,

    • quality metrics,

    • backlog monitoring,

    • capacity planning.

  • Prepare the team to scale toward high-volume onboarding at go-live and beyond.

  • Build a strong team culture based on rigor, accountability, customer protection and continuous learning.

Process design, standardization & scalability

  • Translate regulatory policies into clear operational procedures, SOPs, decision trees and analyst playbooks.

  • Standardize KYB processes to ensure consistency, scalability and a smooth onboarding experience.

  • Identify bottlenecks in workflows and propose operational improvements.

  • Balance compliance rigor with operational efficiency, without compromising Pennylane Financial Services’ risk appetite.

  • Define how KYB processes should evolve during the migration from Swan’s operational model to Pennylane’s own LoD1 setup.

Tooling, automation & Product collaboration

  • Contribute to the implementation and optimization of KYB tooling and back-office workflows.

  • Work closely with Product and Tech teams to design efficient analyst interfaces and operational workflows.

  • Help test KYB tooling before go-live from an operational perspective, not only a technical one.

  • Identify opportunities for automation on repetitive tasks such as document verification, data collection, alert triage or case pre-analysis.

  • Ensure that automation improves efficiency while preserving quality, traceability and risk control.

Quality assurance, controls & reporting

  • Implement a QA framework for KYB operations:

    • random sampling,

    • peer reviews,

    • calibration sessions,

    • error tracking,

    • remediation plans.

  • Monitor operational and risk indicators to detect process weaknesses or compliance issues.

  • Produce regular reporting on KYB performance, risk trends, backlog, SLA adherence and quality.

  • Support Compliance / LoD2 during audits, controls testing and regulatory reviews by providing evidence and operational insights.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Act as the main operational point of contact for KYB-related matters.

  • Work closely with Compliance, Risk, Fraud, Product, Tech, Customer Support and Finance teams.

  • Provide operational input on new features, customer journeys and onboarding requirements.

  • Help Product and Tech teams understand KYB constraints and translate them into pragmatic product decisions.

  • Collaborate with other LoD1 teams, especially Transaction Monitoring and Fraud & Risk, to ensure a coherent customer risk lifecycle.

First 6–12 months priorities

  • Translate the onboarding policy submitted to the regulator into operational procedures, analyst playbooks and escalation rules.

  • Define the KYB team target organization and hiring plan.

  • Build the first version of the KYB performance dashboard and operating cadence.

  • Contribute to the implementation / configuration of KYB and back-office tools.

  • Prepare operational readiness for go-live:

    • team training,

    • runbooks,

    • decision trees,

    • QA process,

    • incident escalation paths,

    • capacity model.

  • Ensure the KYB organization is ready to support ~10,000 onboardings per month while maintaining compliance quality and customer experience.

Profile & must-have experience

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in KYB/KYC, compliance operations, risk operations or financial services operations.

  • Experience in a regulated environment such as a fintech, bank, payment institution, EMI or BaaS / embedded finance provider.

  • Proven experience managing or coordinating operational teams in a high-volume environment.

  • Strong exposure to AML/CTF requirements and business customer onboarding.

  • Experience translating policies into operational processes, SOPs and analyst guidance.

  • Hands-on experience with KYB tooling, back-office tools or workflow automation.

  • Experience working with Product / Tech teams on tooling or process improvements.

  • Bonus: experience with ACPR expectations, licence applications, audits, BaaS migrations or credit-related onboarding.

Technical & operational skills

  • Strong understanding of KYB/KYC workflows for business customers:

    • legal entity verification,

    • UBO identification,

    • document review,

    • risk classification,

    • PEP / sanctions screening,

    • high-risk escalation.

  • Good knowledge of French and European AML/CTF frameworks, including ACPR, TRACFIN and FATF expectations.

  • Ability to design scalable operational processes and performance frameworks.

  • Data-driven approach: comfortable using operational metrics, dashboards and analytics to manage performance.

  • Strong process mindset: able to identify inefficiencies, structure workflows and improve quality at scale.

  • Good judgment in balancing compliance, customer experience and operational efficiency.

  • Ability to contribute meaningfully to tooling design, testing and implementation.

Soft skills

  • Rigorous, structured and accountable.

  • Strong leadership and coaching skills.

  • Excellent communication with operational teams, Compliance, Product, Tech and senior stakeholders.

  • Pragmatic and solution-oriented, able to operate under regulatory constraints without creating unnecessary friction.

  • Comfortable in a greenfield environment with ambiguity, high autonomy and fast execution.

  • Strong pedagogy: able to translate complex regulatory or operational topics into simple, actionable guidance.

  • Customer-conscious: attentive to onboarding friction and customer impact while preserving risk standards.

Languages, Presence & Location

  • Languages:

    • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Location:

    • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

    • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected; partial remote is possible, but this is not a fully remote role.

Why Join Us?

  • Greenfield regulatory project: help build the first line of defense of a new regulated financial entity from scratch.

  • Massive impact: shape how financial services are delivered to hundreds of thousands of French SMEs.

  • High autonomy: own a critical operational domain with direct impact on go-live readiness and customer onboarding.

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

Role context

Pennylane operates today tens of thousands of business accounts through a BaaS model. As Financial Services becomes a larger part of Pennylane’s strategy, we are building Pennylane Financial Services and applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences.

Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers under our own licensed entity by early 2027, before progressively migrating existing customers. To make this possible, we are building the operational foundations of a regulated financial entity across onboarding, transaction monitoring, fraud, risk and payment operations.

As Lead Payment Operations, you will be one of the first operational leaders joining this greenfield setup. Reporting to the General Manager / Head of Operations of Pennylane Financial Services, you will own the operational execution of payment operations across SEPA transfers and direct debits, cards, international transfers, cheques, and cash / collateral management.

Your mission will be to build, structure and scale the payment operations setup needed to support growing volumes, ensure reliable execution, manage incidents, and protect customer experience while embedding the controls expected from a strong first line of defense.

This is a high-autonomy role with direct exposure to a strategic regulatory project, close collaboration with Product, Tech, Compliance, Risk and external payment partners, and the opportunity to shape the payment operating model of a fast-growing fintech serving hundreds of thousands of French SMEs.

Responsibilities

Payment operations & execution

  • Own the end-to-end operational execution of payment operations across:

    • SEPA transfers and direct debits,

    • cards,

    • international transfers,

    • cheques,

    • cash and collateral management.

  • Ensure day-to-day reliability of payment operations, including exception handling, operational follow-up, issue resolution, external requests.

  • Act as the operational point of escalation for payment incidents: triage, coordination, customer impact assessment, mitigation, root cause analysis and durable corrective actions.

  • Maintain strong auditability of operational decisions, reconciliations, exceptions and incidents.

Operating model, controls & scalability

  • Build and continuously improve the payment operations operating model:

    • processes,

    • SLAs,

    • runbooks,

    • documentation,

    • knowledge base,

    • onboarding and training materials.

  • Define clear ownership, escalation paths and rituals for payment operations.

  • Design and embed first-line controls aligned with operational risk, regulatory expectations and customer protection.

  • Implement reconciliation, exception-management and incident-management practices proportionate to the risks of each payment rail.

  • Prepare the function to scale from an initial team of 3 people to around 10 people while maintaining quality, resilience and operational discipline.

Performance management & continuous improvement

  • Define, monitor and report on payment operations KPIs, including:

    • volumes,

    • success rates,

    • exception and error rates,

    • incident frequency and MTTR,

    • backlog,

    • SLA adherence,

    • customer-impact metrics.

  • Use operational data to identify bottlenecks, recurring issues and high-leverage improvement opportunities.

  • Drive continuous improvement cycles to reduce manual work, shorten resolution times and improve reliability.

  • Build the reporting cadence needed to keep internal stakeholders aligned on performance, risks and priorities.

Tooling, automation & Product collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product and Tech teams to shape payment back-office tooling and operational workflows.

  • Translate operational pain points into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria and post-launch monitoring needs.

  • Contribute to operational testing before go-live, beyond technical QA: runbooks, edge cases, incident scenarios, reconciliation and handover processes.

  • Identify and prioritize automation opportunities that improve efficiency, quality and customer experience.

  • Balance automation and manual controls pragmatically during the first scaling phase.

Incident management & customer protection

  • Build a structured incident-management framework for payment operations:

    • severity levels,

    • ownership,

    • communication rhythm,

    • escalation paths,

    • root cause analysis,

    • prevention actions.

  • Coordinate with Customer Support, Product, Tech, Compliance, Risk and external partners during operational incidents.

  • Ensure customer-facing issues such as blocked payments, missing transactions, failed transfers or delayed resolutions are handled with urgency and clarity.

  • Use post-mortems and operational learnings to prevent recurrence and improve customer transparency.

External stakeholder management

  • Build and maintain strong operational relationships with payment processing providers, partner banks and other external stakeholders.

  • Define escalation routines and performance expectations with external partners.

  • Keep providers accountable using facts, metrics and structured follow-up.

  • Ensure third-party dependencies are well understood, monitored and integrated into Pennylane Financial Services’ operating model.

Team build-up & leadership

  • Recruit, onboard, train and manage the payment operations team.

  • Operate as a player/coach: remain hands-on on critical topics while progressively building team capacity and autonomy.

  • Define roles, responsibilities, workload distribution and coverage model.

  • Build a team culture based on ownership, rigor, customer protection, operational excellence and continuous learning.

  • Develop the team’s skills across payment operations, incident management, controls and stakeholder management.

First 6–12 months priorities

  • Map current and target payment operations processes across payment rails and identify operational gaps.

  • Define the target operating model, including rituals, SLAs, controls, escalation paths and reporting.

  • Build the first version of payment operations runbooks, incident procedures and reconciliation framework.

  • Set up operational KPIs and reporting routines.

  • Contribute to the design, testing and launch readiness of payment back-office tooling.

  • Recruit and onboard the first team members while maintaining hands-on ownership of critical operations.

  • Build escalation routines with banks, payment processors and internal stakeholders.

  • Improve customer experience by reducing resolution time, increasing transparency and eliminating recurring operational pain points.

Profile & must-have experience

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in payments operations, financial operations, treasury operations or operational risk in a regulated or high-volume environment.

  • Strong exposure to payment operations across at least part of the scope: SEPA transfers and direct debits, cards, international transfers, cheques, cash management or related payment rails.

  • Proven experience managing operational incidents, including triage, escalation, root cause analysis and prevention.

  • Experience designing scalable operational processes, SLAs, runbooks and controls.

  • Experience working with Product and Tech teams on tooling, workflow improvements or automation.

  • Experience managing or coordinating operational teams, ideally in a player/coach setup.

  • Experience managing external operational stakeholders such as banks, PSPs, payment processors or other financial partners.

  • Bonus: experience in a regulated fintech, payment institution, EMI, bank, BaaS / embedded finance provider, or with a payment-institution licence setup.

Technical & operational skills

  • Strong understanding of payment flows, operational failure modes, exceptions and controls.

  • Good knowledge of first-line-of-defense expectations: operational risk ownership, reconciliations, auditability, exception handling and incident management.

  • Strong process mindset: able to structure workflows, clarify ownership and improve quality at scale.

  • Data-driven approach: comfortable defining KPIs, building operational reporting and using metrics to prioritize improvements.

  • Ability to translate operational pain points into clear Product / Tech requirements.

  • Good judgment in balancing reliability, customer experience, operational efficiency and risk control.

  • Ability to design pragmatic automation and tooling improvements without losing operational control.

Soft skills

  • Rigorous, structured and accountable.

  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to prioritize in an ambiguous, fast-scaling environment.

  • Player/coach leadership: comfortable being hands-on while building a team and operating cadence.

  • Excellent communication under pressure, especially during incidents or partner escalations.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration with Product, Tech, Compliance, Risk, Customer Support and external partners.

  • Customer-conscious: attentive to payment reliability, resolution time and customer impact.

  • Pragmatic and solution-oriented, able to operate under regulatory constraints without creating unnecessary friction.

  • Strong pedagogy: able to explain operational constraints and trade-offs in simple, actionable terms.

Languages, Presence & Location

  • Languages:

    • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Location:

    • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

    • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected; partial remote is possible, but this is not a fully remote role.

Our Vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About Us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 6 years of existence, we've managed to:

  • 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

  • 💰 Raise a total of €225 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 650+ happy Pennylaners: we're now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

  • 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

  • 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

  • 🚀 Already more than 400,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 4,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 

Design at Pennylane

Design sits at the centre of this mission and its purpose is to deliver a seamless, accessible and enjoyable experience for our users. Our team of 40+ product designers work across different tracks that are divided into cross-functional squads each consisting of Engineering, Product and Design. Autonomy, trust and transparency are the key values upon which our culture is built, this is directly reflected in how our designers operate on a day-to-day basis.

 

At Pennylane, designers are expected to actively contribute all the way from defining the problem space, to research and testing.

 

We are seeking a Design System Designer to grow and maintain Purse, our design system, alongside our Design System Manager. You will own the craft of the system at the component level: building tokens, components, and patterns that 40+ designers and engineers rely on every day across web, mobile, and tablet, in multiple languages.

You'll partner closely with engineering on design–code parity, with product designers as their support for system usage, and with our Design System Manager on the long-term direction of Purse. If you love the craft of system design, defining APIs, modeling tokens, writing documentation that's beautifully clear for both humans and AI, and care about how a great system shapes a great product, you'll thrive at Pennylane.

 
 

What you'll bring

 

Design System Expertise

  • Hands-on experience contributing to a design system at scale: designing components, defining variants and APIs, modeling tokens, and maintaining Figma libraries used by 40+ designers

  • Strong understanding of design token systems, semantic naming, and theming / multi-brand patterns

  • Skilled at running design system audits, spotting inconsistencies in product surfaces, and bringing them back into the system

  • Experience writing component documentation that is clear for designers, engineers, and product managers

  • Expertise in what makes a design system interpretable and usable by AI: structured content, machine-readable patterns, AI-ready documentation conventions, and how an LLM or codegen agent consumes a design system

  • Solid grounding in accessibility (WCAG) and inclusive design practices

Mindset

  • You want to push the design system toward an ambitious vision, but you know how to slice the path into small intermediate milestones that deliver value at every step, rather than waiting for the perfect end state

  • You are pragmatic: you don't overthink, you don't always work by the book, and you know when a "good enough" solution beats a perfect one

  • You are curious about how design systems are evolving in 2026 (AI, codegen, token automation, MCP)

  • You enjoy switching between deep craft work and pragmatic system-level decisions

Technical Partnership

  • Strong technical acumen with a clear understanding of how design systems are implemented in code

  • Comfortable working in a production-first environment where code is the source of truth, and Figma reflects what ships

  • Experience partnering with engineering teams to ensure design–code parity and smooth implementation of new components

Enablement & Communication

  • Experience supporting product designers through office hours, a support model, or peer review

  • Demonstrated ability to evangelize a design system, present design rationale, and translate component-level decisions for non-design stakeholders

  • Ability to handle complex support requests and turn recurring questions into permanent improvements (docs, lint rules, worked examples)

 

Nice to have

  • Experience with B2B SaaS products or fintech environments

  • Familiarity with multi-language / internationalization design challenges

  • Experience contributing to or maintaining a tokens pipeline (Style Dictionary, Tokens Studio, MCP-based pipelines)

  • Background in accessibility standards and inclusive design practices

  • Experience working in fast-growing scale-ups

 

Your key responsibilities

 

  • Build and maintain components, patterns, and tokens in Purse, partnering closely with engineering to ensure design–code parity across web, mobile, and tablet

  • Write and maintain component documentation that serves designers, engineers, and AI tools — including usage rules, anatomy, variants, accessibility, and worked examples

  • Run audits, support product designers, and turn recurring needs into systemic improvements, working alongside the Design System Manager to evolve Purse toward our long-term vision through incremental, high-value milestones

Language requirement: You are able to communicate well in both English and French.

 
 

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

  • 🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

  • 🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

  • 💵 You'll have a competitive compensation package

  • 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

  • 🏡 You'll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

  • ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you'll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

  • 🇬🇧 You'll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

  • 💻 You'll get the latest Apple equipment

  • 🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

     

  • If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks: 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

 

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 
 

Who are we looking for?

 

To thrive at Pennylane, you need:

  • To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you're applying to)

  • To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

  • To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

  • Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don't feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you're hesitating, we encourage you to apply: who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we're doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

- Partner with the product leadership to define, prioritize, and implement operational roadmaps aligned with business objectives

- Design and establish scalable operational frameworks that support our growth

 

Data-driven decision making

- Lead comprehensive analyses to identify market opportunities, operational inefficiencies, and growth levers

- Develop actionable insights and recommendations based on quantitative and qualitative research

 

Project leadership

- Spearhead strategic initiatives and pilot programs from ideation through implementation and measurement

- Identify and manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

 

Cross-functional orchestration

- Serve as the operational nexus between the track and horizontal teams including care, sales, and the other product teams impacted by the electronic invoicing reform

- Facilitate effective collaboration and alignment across organizational boundaries

 

Performance management

- Own the OKR process for the track, ensuring clarity of objectives and accountability for results

- Design and implement robust tracking mechanisms to monitor performance against key metrics

- Proactively identify performance gaps and develop action plans to address them

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations or a related field, with a strong record of scaling business operations in dynamic environments

- Proven track record of translating strategic initiatives into executable operational plans and projects, delivering measurable business impact

- Proficiency in SQL (or willingness to learn) and modern data analysis tools to drive decision-making independently

 

Core competencies

- Strategic vision: ability to connect business objectives with operational requirements while maintaining focus on long-term goals

- Analytical excellence: skilled at distilling complex data into actionable insights that drive business outcomes

- Project management rigor: experience leading cross-functional initiatives from conception to implementation

- Communication and influence: exceptional ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuade diverse stakeholders

- Problem-solving orientation: demonstrated ability to identify root causes and develop innovative, practical solutions

AI & Continuous Improvement

Artificial Intelligence is one of the topics owned by the IT team.

You’ll help identify valuable AI use cases, support the deployment of approved AI tools and encourage responsible AI adoption across the company.

Freelance Senior Product Manager / Product Consultant (w/m/d) – Abrechnung & ERP | Remote
jobs.description:
Du möchtest ein klar definiertes Produktprojekt übernehmen, komplexe Fachprozesse strukturieren und Anforderungen in konkrete Produktlösungen für eine eigens entwickelte ERP-Software übersetzen? Dann suchen wir Dich für ein freiberufliches Projektmandat als: 


Freelance Product Manager (w/m/d) - Abrechnung & ERP - 3 bis 6 Monate

Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 48 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Das Projekt:

Für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Softwarelösung ginisuite suchen wir freiberufliche Unterstützung für ein zeitlich befristetes Produktprojekt. Der Projektstart ist zum 01.10.2026 vorgesehen. Die geplante Projektlaufzeit beträgt zunächst drei bis sechs Monate.

Die ginisuite ist unsere eigens entwickelte ERP-/PVS-Lösung für Arbeitsmedizin und Arbeitssicherheit. Im Fokus des Projekts steht die fachliche und produktseitige Weiterentwicklung ausgewählter Module in den Bereichen Vertragsmanagement, Abrechnung, Zeiterfassung und Buchhaltung.

Zu den Projektinhalten gehören die Analyse bestehender Fachprozesse, die Entwicklung geeigneter Lösungskonzepte sowie die Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in umsetzbare User Stories und Tickets. Darüber hinaus umfasst das Mandat die fachliche Begleitung ausgewählter Themen bis zur Qualitätssicherung, Veröffentlichung, Datenmigration und Einführung.

Die Zusammenarbeit erfolgt grundsätzlich remote innerhalb Deutschlands auf freiberuflicher Basis mit eigenverantwortlicher Zeiteinteilung und klar vereinbarten Projektergebnissen. Bei Bedarf können einzelne projektbezogene Termine innerhalb Deutschlands erforderlich sein, voraussichtlich etwa einmal pro Monat und nach vorheriger Abstimmung. 

Dein Projektinhalte:

Fachliche Konzeption und Produktentwicklung

  • Analyse bestehender Prozesse und Systemlandschaften in den Bereichen Vertragsmanagement, Abrechnung, Zeiterfassung und Buchhaltung

  • Identifikation und Priorisierung fachlicher Optimierungspotenziale auf Grundlage der vereinbarten Projektziele

  • Entwicklung geeigneter Lösungsansätze und konkreter Empfehlungen für die Weiterentwicklung ausgewählter ginisuite-Module

  • Erstellung nachvollziehbarer Fachkonzepte, User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien und Tickets als Grundlage für die technische Umsetzung

  • Übersetzung komplexer fachlicher Anforderungen in klare und umsetzbare Produktentscheidungen

Umsetzungs- & Rolloutbegleitung

  • Fachliche Begleitung der im Projekt vereinbarten Entwicklungspakete

  • Vorbereitung und Durchführung fachlicher Qualitätssicherungen

  • Projektbezogene Unterstützung bei Release-Vorbereitungen, Datenmigrationen und Rollouts

  • Dokumentation der erarbeiteten Konzepte, Entscheidungen und Projektergebnisse

  • Strukturierte Übergabe der vereinbarten Ergebnisse an die zuständigen Ansprechpartner:innen bei Arsipa

Projektbezogene Abstimmung

  • Selbstständige Planung und Umsetzung der eigenen Projektaktivitäten innerhalb des vereinbarten Zeitraums

  • Projektbezogene Abstimmung mit dem Lead Product Manager, dem CTO und weiteren relevanten Ansprechpartner:innen

  • Aufnahme fachlicher Anforderungen ausgewählter Tochtergesellschaften

  • Fachlicher Austausch mit dem Entwicklungsteam sowie internen und externen Projektbeteiligten, beispielsweise aus dem Data-Warehouse-Umfeld

  • Transparente Abstimmung zu Projektfortschritt, Ergebnissen, Abhängigkeiten und fachlichen Entscheidungsbedarfen

  • Einbringung eigener methodischer Ansätze und fachlicher Empfehlungen

Dein Profil:

  • Fundierte Erfahrung als Product Manager:in, Product Owner:in, Product Consultant oder in einer vergleichbaren produktbezogenen Projektfunktion

  • Nachweisbare Projekterfahrung in den Bereichen Rechnungswesen, ERP, Abrechnung oder vergleichbaren B2B-Softwarelösungen

  • Erfahrung in der Analyse komplexer Fachprozesse und deren Übersetzung in konkrete Produktanforderungen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit User Stories, Tickets, Akzeptanzkriterien und fachlichen Produktkonzepten

  • Technisches Verständnis in den Bereichen Datenmigration, Datenanalyse und Softwareentwicklung

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise

Hilfreich für das Projekt sind außerdem:

  • Erfahrung in SaaS-, Plattform- oder ERP-nahen Projekten

  • Kenntnisse cloudbasierter Plattformen, APIs, Integrationen oder verteilter Systeme

  • Verständnis für Softwarearchitektur, Microservices oder containerbasierte Systemlandschaften

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Legacy-Systemen und Migrationen zwischen Bestands- und Zielsystemen

  • Projekterfahrung in Multi-Entity-, Private-Equity-, Buy-&-Build- oder vergleichbaren Wachstumsumfeldern

  • Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Occupational Health & Safety, Arbeitsmedizin oder Arbeitssicherheit

  • Interim-, Freelancer- oder Beratungserfahrung im Product-Management-Umfeld

Rahmenbedingungen des Projekts:

  • Freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit auf Projektbasis

  • Projektstart zum 01.10.2026

  • Geplante Projektlaufzeit von zunächst drei bis sechs Monaten

  • Voraussichtlicher Projektumfang von ca. 30 bis 40 Stunden pro Woche

  • Remote innerhalb Deutschlands mit eigenverantwortlicher Zeiteinteilung

  • Einzelne projektbezogene Termine innerhalb Deutschlands können bei Bedarf und nach vorheriger Abstimmung erforderlich sein

  • Vergütung auf Basis eines individuell vereinbarten Stunden- oder Tagessatzes gegen Rechnungsstellung

  • Zusammenarbeit auf Basis klar definierter Projektziele und Projektergebnisse, nicht im Rahmen einer Festanstellung

Was Dich bei diesem Projekt erwartet:

  • Klar definiertes Produktmandat: Ein zeitlich befristetes Projekt mit konkretem Fokus auf die Weiterentwicklung ausgewählter ERP- und Abrechnungsmodule

  • Remote und flexible Umsetzung: Die Projektleistung kann grundsätzlich remote erbracht und zeitlich eigenverantwortlich organisiert werden

  • Relevanter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entwickelst eigene fachliche Lösungsansätze und bringst Deine Produkt- und Projekterfahrung gezielt ein

  • Direkter Zugang zu relevanten Informationen: Für eine effiziente Projektumsetzung erhältst Du die erforderlichen Informationen zu Fachprozessen, Systemen und Projektzielen

  • Anspruchsvolles Technologieumfeld: Das Projekt verbindet ERP, Abrechnung, Datenmigration, Softwareentwicklung und operative Fachprozesse

  • Dynamisches Wachstumsumfeld: Die ginisuite ist Teil einer PE-backed Buy-&-Build-Plattform mit zahlreichen Gesellschaften und unterschiedlichen fachlichen Anforderungen

  • Professionelle Projektzusammenarbeit: Dich erwarten klare Ansprechpartner:innen, strukturierte Abstimmungen und gemeinsam definierte Projektergebnisse

Unser Auswahlprozess: 

In einem fachlichen Austausch besprechen wir Deine relevante Projekterfahrung, Verfügbarkeit, mögliche Projektkapazität, Arbeitsweise und Honorarvorstellung. Außerdem erhältst Du weitere Informationen zum Projektkontext, zur ginisuite und zu den angestrebten Projektergebnissen. 

Bitte sende uns für die erste Einschätzung:

  • Dein aktuelles Freelancer-Profil

  • Deine Verfügbarkeit ab dem 01.10.2026

  • Deine mögliche Projektkapazität

  • Deinen gewünschten Stunden- oder Tagessatz

  • Relevante Referenzprojekte, insbesondere im ERP-, Abrechnungs- oder B2B-Softwareumfeld

 

Für weitere Fragen stehen wir Dir gerne jederzeit zur Verfügung!

Werde Teil unserer spannenden Reise bei der Arsipa Gruppe - Wir freuen uns auf Dich!
