About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon in Europe!). In 5 years of existence, we've managed to:

  • 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

  • 💰 Raise a total of €400 million, including from Sequoia — the famous Silicon Valley fund that invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe and Paypal

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1,000 happy Pennylaners, and earn a place among the greatest companies to work for in France (and remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor

  • 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities and a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of employees already work from all parts of Europe

  • 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms, with outstanding ratings

  • 🚀 Reach more than 1,000,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,000 accounting firms using Pennylane in France

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

Pennylane is becoming the financial OS of European SMEs and accounting firms. And a growing share of the work done inside our product will come from agents, not only from humans. Our AI strategy operates at three layers: verticalized AI embedded in the product (Copilot & Autopilot), an agent interface that makes Pennylane readable and actionable by AIs (tools, MCP), and the Pennylane orchestrator agent itself (Studio Assistant).

Models are commoditizing fast. What makes the difference is everything around them: the harness, the context, the tools, the guardrails. And the evaluation that proves it works on real accounting workflows. That is exactly what this role owns.

By joining us as an AI Engineer, you will have a pivotal role in large projects, bringing your software engineering and applied LLM / agentic systems expertise to help us meet our high delivery standards, at scale and with the level of trust our users require.

HOW you will contribute to the company as an AI Engineer

As an AI Engineer, you will be part of one of our ML & AI teams (25+ people, growing from 2 to 5 teams by the end of 2026), depending on your profile and our needs:

  • AI Capabilities & Infrastructure (CAPI) : the shared foundations every squad builds on: agent harness, agentic runtime & sandboxing, model gateway, tool registry & MCP, guardrails, observability, LLM FinOps, and reusable AI capabilities.

  • Agent Behaviour : making our agents behave correctly, safely and measurably: behaviour steering, domain tuning, evaluation methodology & harness, and later model fine-tuning.

  • Studio Assistant : the financial orchestrator agent for accountants and SMEs: understanding intent, picking tools, launching jobs, producing reports, asking for validation when needed.

Whichever team you join, the core of the job is the same:

  • You will build and harden agentic loops in production : LLM call orchestration, tool calling, streaming & events, error recovery, checkpointing and resumability. With security, permissions and cost in mind (agentic RBAC, audit trail, isolated execution, token and latency budgets).

  • You will own context & memory engineering: context construction, retrieval, compaction, short- and long-term memory, and the latency / cost trade-offs that come with them.

  • You will make Pennylane usable by agents, turning business capabilities into well-specified, documented, versioned and tested tools exposed internally and through MCP, and steering agent behaviour (system prompts and instructions, skills, planning and tool-selection strategies, guardrails, anti-prompt-injection).

  • You will treat evaluation as a first-class discipline: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, human eval, regression tracking and error analysis. Turning production failures into systematic improvements.

  • You will collaborate with Product teams and domain experts (accountants) on live use cases : ComptAssistant, Studio Assistant, MCP, document extraction, Autopilot bookkeeping, revision. To make sure that fulfilling real user needs is always at the center of what we do.

  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Continuously monitor the AI landscape for emerging trends, State-of-the-Art (SOTA) models, and breakthrough research (e.g., new LLM architectures, multimodal AI, and optimization techniques).

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane

Within one month:

  • You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.

  • You will get familiar with our stack and AI tooling (agent harness, tool registry & MCP, evaluation and observability tooling, model gateway), and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.

  • You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of our product and operations.

Within 3 months:

  • You will be fully in charge of items in our roadmap, defining and prioritizing your tasks autonomously, and will own an agentic use case end to end in production, together with its evaluation set and quality metrics.

  • You will be comfortable with our technical stack (Python, agentic frameworks & MCP, evaluation and observability tooling, Kubernetes & AWS).

  • You will contribute to larger cross-team projects.

Within 6 months:

  • You will proactively contribute to the team's roadmap.

  • You will work with engineers and data practitioners on improving our agent harness, our evaluation practices and our AI platform.

  • You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.

And beyond: the ML & AI teams will continue growing with the company

Which means:

  • Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members,

  • Increased accountability in project leadership,

  • Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.

Who are we looking for?

You're the right candidate if you:

  • Have 5–8 years of experience and are very strong in Python

  • Hands-on experience building LLM and agentic systems at scale in production: prompting, tool use, context construction, RAG, and handling failure, state and reliability (not just calling a model API).

  • Treat evaluation as a first-class discipline: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, human eval, A/B testing, and measuring agent quality, regressions and edge cases.

  • Have a good grasp of applied LLM / ML and AI infrastructure (model serving, vector databases, cost and latency).

  • Nice to have: model fine-tuning and post-training (SFT, DPO, RL), MCP, and familiarity with Ruby.

  • Have a balanced blend of technical, business and product skills, communicate well (including with non-technical domain experts), and are fluent in English (French is not mandatory).

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager

  • A case study interview to discuss a topic closely related to one of our priorities (75 min)

  • A past-project interview to hear about your experience (60 min)

  • An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (60 min)

What we do to make your work life easier

  • 🌴 Wherever you are based, you'll get 25 vacation days paid by Pennylane

  • 💵 You'll have a competitive compensation package

  • 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

  • 🏡 You'll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

  • ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you'll have access to 8,000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 wellness activities

  • 🇬🇧 You'll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

  • 💻 You'll get the latest Apple equipment

  • 🏢 Depending on the team and the requirements of the position, you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

  • 🎉 We regularly come together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 2 months) and our annual company seminar

If you are based in France, you'll have a French contract following French regulation, on top of the additional perks: 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks of PTO, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover, and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly present (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…).

We're working on providing those last advantages to people based outside of France as well, though it can be more complex depending on the country.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

  • Applications through official channels only: apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

  • Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com.

  • We will never ask you for payment or financial information (bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent — please do not respond and report it to us immediately.

We fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion, and we're committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are.

If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

jobs.title: Go to Market Manager
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 million de TPE/PME et plus de 9000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Le Go-To-Market chez Pennylane : La stratégie de Go-To-Market occupe une place centrale chez Pennylane. Elle ne se limite pas à lancer de nouvelles fonctionnalités, mais incarne une véritable philosophie visant à anticiper les besoins du marché, tout en maximisant notre revenu et notre impact commercial. C’est le pont stratégique entre nos équipes Produit, Marketing et Vente.

L’objectif : Notre mission est d'établir une stratégie de conquête et de monétisation durable et scalable. En tant que GTM Manager, tu seras le garant et le référent de notre Go-to-Market (sur les segments Cabinets ou Large SME), permettant d'atteindre nos objectifs ambitieux de croissance tout en assurant un positionnement clair et compétitif.

Le quotidien : Tu seras le/la responsable de notre stratégie Go to market, l’interlocuteur privilégié entre le business, le produit, le pricing, et la personne qui porte la responsabilité de la performance de nos offres. Au cœur du réacteur, tu auras un impact direct sur notre trajectoire de croissance. Tu seras notamment amené(e) à réaliser :

  • Stratégie & Analyse de marché : Être le garant de la veille concurrentielle chez Pennylane. Définir les bons ICP (Ideal Customer Profiles) sur chaque marché. Définir un forecast annuel ambitieux par marché et en assurer le reporting rigoureux.

  • Pricing & Offres : Définir et créer les bonnes offres tarifaires pour chaque marché. Arbitrer le positionnement de chaque fonctionnalité (feature) sur nos différents plans. Cadrer notre politique de discount interne et définir les Opérations commerciales.

  • Exécution & Transversalité : Agir comme un véritable conseiller stratégique auprès du top management**,** s’assurer de la faisabilité technique de la mise en place de chaque offre (CRM, PL). Apporter la vision business aux Product Managers (PM) pour la construction et la priorisation de la roadmap.

  • Enablement & Rayonnement : Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Enablement et Marketing pour définir les messages clés de chaque fonctionnalité importante. Mettre à disposition des commerciaux les bons outils d'aide à la vente .

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons un profil ambitieux, doté d'un fort "ownership" (mindset entrepreneur), avec un grand sens business, une appétence forte pour la compréhension d’un marché, la gestion de projets complexes, l'analyse de données et la collaboration transverse. Tu incarnes les valeurs de Pennylane (Care for SMEs, Radical Trust, Community of Builders).

Le candidat idéal a les compétences et expériences suivantes :

  • Expérience : Au moins 3 années réussies dans une position de Chef de marché, Growth Manager, Responsable stratégie commerciale, ou Product Marketing Manager (PMM). Une expérience sur le marché BtoB SaaS en Comptabilité / Gestion financière est un énorme plus.

  • Connaissance Marché & Pricing : Maîtrise de l'écosystème SaaS, IA. Appétence pour les logiciels de gestion/compta, la facturation électronique et leurs personaes (DAF, Comptables, Dirigeants). Tu as déjà une expérience dans la définition d’offre, de pricing BtoB et tu sais anticiper les tendances à M+6 ou M+12.

  • Gestion de projets complexes : Impact-driven et pragmatique, tu sais établir une roadmap, lever des bloqueurs et gérer des projets en toute autonomie avec de multiples parties prenantes (PMM, Pricing, Ops, Sales...).

  • Profil analytique : Habileté à définir tes priorités en fonction du potentiel business, à créer un business plan / forecast avec des hypothèses probantes, et forte maîtrise des outils data (BI, Excel, IA).

  • Excellente communication : Capacité à interagir avec des C-Levels et Head of Sales. Tu sais structurer, vulgariser, synthétiser des problèmes complexes et embarquer les équipes avec toi en adoptant une posture de consultant.

Process de recrutement

  • Une première rencontre (Screening) avec Marie, Talent Acquisition (30 min)

  • Un entretien avec Charles pour creuser ton parcours (1h)

  • Présentation d’un Case Study avec Charles et Eric, Hugo ou Edouard

  • Entretien Culture Fit (45 min) avec Anouk, Sarah, Clem, Alex, Jocelyn ou Valentin et Jacob

  • Dernière étape (45 min) avec Edouard (Cofondateur) et Brieuc ou Arthur

jobs.title: Head of FinCrime Ops
jobs.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Context

Reporting directly to the COO, you will be responsible for the application of the company LCB-FT and risk policies on both payment & credit scopes. You will be monitoring and optimizing the performance of the first line of defense, including onboarding, transaction monitoring, fraud & risk.

We are currently operating approximately 30k business accounts under a BaaS model. The role of Financial Services in Pennylane’s strategy is set to grow, both in terms of revenue and product contribution, to serve our 750k+ current customer base.

As such, we are initiating a process to get licensed as Etablissement de paiement et Société de financement to meet our current functional scope at the very least. Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers by early 2027 before starting migrating existing customers.

To meet this ambition, we are starting to hire our Tech, Product, Compliance and Ops leaders.

Your mission would be to :

  • Build & lead three teams of analysts (KYB, Transaction monitoring, Risk & Fraud)

  • Deploy LCB-FT policies & control their proper application by your teams

  • Contribute to KYB & TM tooling implementation & team training

  • Optimize the efficiency of your teams and tools, leveraging AI and automating processes while protecting at all cost our risk appetite

  • Work in close collaboration with the Compliance & Fraud & Risk teams of the LoD2

This is a greenfield project with high autonomy and responsibility, direct exposure to regulators, and the opportunity to shape the operations of a fast-growing fintech with a robust pre-existing customer base

Responsibilities phasing

  • Phase 1 (pre-licence & migration, 2026-2027) :

    • Work closely with the COO & Strategic Project Manager to support licence application and customer migration from BaaS to EP

    • Focus 100% on payment operations (KYB, TM, Fraud) and building LoD1 infrastructure

  • Phase 2 (post-licence, 2027+) :

    • Progressively integrate credit operations (credit assessment & decisioning) as the Société de Financement scope ramps up

    • Scale LoD1 to support both payment and credit activities across a growing customer base

Missions & objectives

Operations program

  • Build and scale LoD1 from 30k to 300k+ accounts within 24 months post-licence

    • Recruit, onboard and train 3 operational teams: KYB/KYC L1 (target: 15-20 FTE), Transaction Monitoring L1 (target: 10-15 FTE), Fraud & Risk L1 (target: 5-8 FTE)

    • Define team structures, roles, responsibilities, and career paths aligned with regulatory requirements

    • Establish SLAs and performance frameworks for each team

    • Define collaboration models with Pennylane SAS (agent of Pennylane Financial Services) and with the LoD2

  • Own the full operational lifecycle: onboarding → transaction monitoring → fraud detection → offboarding

  • Manage budget and forecasting for LoD1 operations (headcount, tools, training)

Norms, Policies & Procedures application

  • Deploy and enforce LCB-FT policies defined by translating regulatory obligations into daily operations

    • Ensure 100% compliance with KYB/KYC workflows: customer risk classification, high-risk escalations, PEP screening, sanctions checks

    • Execute transaction monitoring rules as defined by Compliance, escalate L2 alerts to TM L2 within SLA

    • Apply fraud detection policies and manage escalation to Fraud & Risk L2

  • Challenge policy applicability when operational friction is excessive; propose pragmatic adjustments to LoD2 while maintaining risk appetite

  • Apply credit & merchant risk policies as per our risk classification

Tools & process automation

  • Own vendors relationship for LoD1 tooling (SLAs monitoring, escalations, improvements)

  • Deploy AI-powered automation on repetitive tasks: document verification, anomaly detection, alert triage

  • Own back-office access management for all LoD1 teams (suspend, block, temporary wallets)

  • Contribute to design the back-office of your teams by collaborating with a dedicated Product squad

Performance optimization

  • Own monitoring & reporting KPIs : definition of metrics, development of performance dashboard & reporting

  • Identify bottlenecks in workflows and tooling and implement corrective actions

  • Implement QA framework (random sampling, calibration sessions, peer reviews…)

  • Run continuous improvement cycles by implementing red-bin processes & collaborating with LoD2

  • Benchmark performance against industry standards (other EPs, fintechs)

  • Leverage data analytics to predict operational load and adjust team capacity proactively

  • Consider outsourcing to BPOs and own the integration & deployment of this strategy

Training & Advisory

  • Train LoD1 teams on LCB-FT requirements, tooling, escalation procedures

  • Translate complex compliance requirements into simple, actionable guidance for product, business & tech counterparts

  • Act as operational advisor to Product on new features: assess feasibility, identify compliance risks, propose mitigations

  • Develop training materials: playbooks, SOPs, decision trees for analysts

Governance & Reporting

  • Participate in quarterly risk committees with LoD2 and Executive Committee

  • Maintain audit trails for all operational decisions (KYB rejections, TM escalations, fraud cases) to ensure regulatory traceability

  • Coordinate with LoD2 on controls testing: provide evidence, remediate gaps identified by internal audits

  • Support Lod2 on regulatory reporting (incidents escalation, statistics, potential support to LoD2 analysts for SAR)

  • Defines & executes operational crisis protocols, post-mortem analysis & remediation plans

Team Leadership

  • Recruit and lead a multi-layer organization of ~80 FTEs across KYB L1, TM L1, Fraud & Risk L1 within 18 months

  • Build your N-1 lines with dedicated performance framework and dedicated team cultures

  • Foster a culture of rigor, accountability, and continuous learning

  • Ensure work-life balance despite operational intensity; implement shift rotations, on-call schedules

  • Develop talent internally: promote high performers, create senior analyst / team lead roles

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Tech, Product, Compliance, and Risk teams

Projects & expansion

  • Accompany licence passporting to other European markets, starting with Germany : own organization evolution, localization and process adaptation

  • Plan & accompany customers migration out of the BaaS model together with the Strategic Project Manager overseeing our licence project (knowledge transfer, incident management, coordination)

Credit risk assessment & decisioning

  • Deploy credit risk policies defined by LoD2 across all credit products (wallet financing, invoice financing, BNPL)

  • Manage credit origination workflows

  • Monitor active credit portfolio by tracking repayment schedules & low signals

  • Challenge risk policies when operational friction blocks growth

  • Oversee credit risk performance and implement credit decisioning tools

Profile & Must‑Have Experience

Experience

  • 8+ years in financial services operations, ideally in a regulated fintech, bank, or payment institution

  • 3+ years managing LoD1 operations (KYB/KYC, transaction monitoring, fraud & risk) in a regulated environment

  • Direct experience with ACPR or similar EU regulator (AMF, BaFin, FCA): licence application, audits, reporting

  • Track record in scaling environment

  • Hands-on experience implementing and optimizing LCB-FT tooling

  • Experience working under dual reporting (operational + compliance) in a 3 Lines of Defense model

  • Bonus: experience in credit operations (Société de financement scope) or BaaS partnerships

Technical Skills

  • Deep knowledge of French AML/CTF regulations: ACPR requirements, TRACFIN obligations, FATF standards

  • Operational expertise in KYB/KYC workflows, transaction monitoring rules (scenario design, thresholds), fraud typologies

  • Data-driven approach: proficient in analytics tools (SQL, BI dashboards), able to interpret operational metrics and drive decisions

  • Tooling evaluation and implementation: ability to assess vendors, negotiate contracts, lead integrations with Tech teams

  • Process automation and AI: understanding of ML-based fraud detection, RPA for document processing, chatbots for L1 support

  • Risk appetite calibration: able to balance compliance rigor with operational efficiency without compromising risk posture

Soft Skills

  • Strong leadership and ability to influence

  • Excellent communication skills across all levels (Board, regulators, operational teams)

  • Rigorous, principled, and accountable

  • Pragmatic, impact‑driven approach, capable of operating under strong regulatory constraints without blocking innovation.

  • Comfortable operating in a dual posture of operations and advisory, with clear boundaries between the two

  • Strong pedagogy: able to explain complex operations to product managers, engineers and founders in simple, actionable terms.

  • Challenging yet constructive: comfortable questioning senior leaders, while remaining solution‑oriented and business‑minded.

Languages, Presence & Location

  • Languages: Fluent French and English are mandatory

  • Location:

    • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

    • Regular on‑site presence in Paris is expected; partial remote is possible, but this is not a fully remote role.

Why Join Us?

  • Greenfield regulatory project: Be the architect of a new regulated entity, from licence application to operational rollout.

  • Massive impact: Shape the way financial services are delivered to hundreds of thousands of French SMEs.

  • High autonomy & influence:

    • Direct, regular interaction with the COO

    • Central role in sustaining the scale of the entity while applying its risk classification

  • Fast‑growing fintech environment:

    • Work closely with top‑tier product and engineering teams.

    • Help invent the next generation of SME financial services under a robust, modern compliance and risk framework.

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity components aligned with impact and responsibility.

Hiring process

  • HR interview with Lucie (Senior Recruiter)

  • Who interview Stanislas de Villoutreys (Head of Legal, Compliance and Risk) and Maxime Leclercq (General Manager Financial Services)

  • Case Stanislas and Eric Scaramozzino (VP Strategic Initiatives)

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

 

While some companies count on marketing and sales to gain market share, we are a product-led company and we are investing primarily on building an innovative and scalable platform. Tech teams have a crucial role to play to achieve this goal.

 

HOW you will contribute to the company as a Software Engineer

 

As a Software Engineer, you would will be part of a 400+ people Tech organisation. Each engineer is part of a squad focussing on a part of the product, reporting to a Team Lead or an Engineering Manager.

Each squad is made with all the skills needed to build features end to end in autonomy, you will be working daily with a product manager, a designer and software engineers.

 

As a Software Engineer you will take part of the discovery phase of the projects with the Product Manager and Designer to define the feature to build; then you will participate with other engineers to design the software architecture, build it, test it and release it to production.

The squad is also working on supporting customers using the features built by monitoring and fixing issues in production.

 

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane

 

Within one month :

 

- You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.

- You will follow a tech onboarding training to get familiar with the application, the accounting concepts, the code stack (we use Ruby 3, Ruby on Rails 7, AWS, React, TypeScript) and the CI/CD and have full autonomy with it.

- You are integrated in your squad and explained your squad scope, roles and responsibilities.

- You will have a “tech buddy”, another engineer, helping you on a daily basis with all the technical details you need to know at Pennylane.

- You will start working on what we call “good first issues” to get familiar with the dev environment, the code structure, the tools and the squad scopes.

 

Within 3-6 months :

 

- You’ll contribute to meaningful new features or improvements in your team’s scope

- You’ll have the opportunity to improve on our tools and processes to help us achieve better quality and/or velocity

- You’ll be included in at least once code review specialist group to decide and improve the adoption of our best practices on one topic (e.g. testing, code architecture, database migrations, etc)

- You’ll start looking into quantitative and qualitative product feedback to sharpen the team’s roadmap

 
 

And beyond :

 

- The teams are growing, there are plenty of opportunity to grow and develop your skills as a software engineer.

- You will be able to take ownership and gain responsibilities on some features or projects the squad is responsible for.

- You will have the possibility to have impact at Pennylane scale by working on cross teams or transversal initiatives.

- You will participate in scaling the Pennylane application from 30k+ customers to millions customers.

 

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from anywhere in Europe, as long as your contract allows you to

💵 You’ll have a compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your english or your french

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🎉 You’ll be part of a vibrant social community : we do lots of sports together (Foot, running, climbing...), we love to hang out and have a drink together (thursday afterwork drinks on our rooftop is a usual thing. Twice-a-year we do company seminars, last time we went on a trip to the French Alps and it was fabulous !)

 

And.. If you're based in France :

 

🏢 You’ll be able to work fully from your home or any co-working space in France, or from our wonderful office in the center of Paris

🏝You’ll get between 6 to 13 additional days off (to the 25 standard ones) to rest and do what you love each year

🍜 You’ll have lunch credits (Swile card) to buy your favorite food every day

🏥 You’ll have a great healthcare cover (Alan Blue) to take care of yourself and your family

 

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

What does the recruitment process look like ? 

 

- You will first have a general chat with a Talent Acquisition Manager - 30 min

- You’ll then have a test-home assignment + a debriefing session with two of our engineers - 1 h

- You’ll have a last discussion with two people from our tech leadership team - 1 h

 

We make sure we move fast ; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total. 

 

🥇 You’re the right candidate if you:

 

- Have at least 4 years of experience with Ruby on Rails

- Have a balanced blend of technical, business, and product skills.

- Show empathy for your users and want to solve real issues for them

- Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly

- Are Fluent in English (French is not mandatory)

- Are a team player and have experience working in an agile environment.

 

We have tried to give you as much details as we could about the purpose, missions and environment of this role; it is now up to you to tell us if you think this is a position in which you could a) have fun and b) bring value to our company.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply anyway: worst case scenario, you might lose a few minutes, and in the best case, it will be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

We also want to emphasise that we fully embrace diversity and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment. We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

To end with a humble illustration of our commitment, we’ve recently signed the Pacte Parité to set concrete goals in building a better and more inclusive workplace in the years to come.

jobs.title: Director Sales Engineering (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

LiveEO transforms Earth Observation data and AI into actionable intelligence for critical infrastructure and supply-chain operators around the world. Our platforms Treeline, SurfaceScout, and TradeAware, help utilities, energy companies, rail operators, and global supply chains monitor vegetation risk, third-party interference, ground changes, and deforestation exposure across millions of kilometers of assets and supply chains, from space.

We're hiring our first Sales Engineering team lead to build and lead a truly global Sales Engineering organization, unifying our regional SE teams across North America, EMEA, and APAC into one consistent, high-performing technical sales function. This is a player-leader role for someone who has run distributed technical teams before, speaks fluently in geospatial and remote-sensing technology, has sold software-enabled services rather than pure-play SaaS, and has embedded MEDDPICC and value-selling discipline into a sales engine at scale.

As Director Sales Engineering (f/m/x), you will own the strategy, people, and technical rigor behind LiveEO's global pre-sales motion. You'll lead a team of regional Sales Engineers, act as the company's most senior technical voice with enterprise customers, and be the standard-bearer for how LiveEO qualifies, quantifies, and wins deals. You'll partner closely with the VP Pre-Sales & Professional Services, VP Sales, CRO, and Product leadership to make sure every region sells with the same technical credibility, the same value discipline, and the same customer-first mindset.


Your challenge

1. Global Team Leadership

  • Build, lead, and scale an international Sales Engineering team across North America, EMEA, and APAC; own hiring, onboarding, coaching, and career development for regional SEs and SE managers.

  • Set global SE strategy, headcount plan, and capacity model aligned to pipeline coverage and quota targets.

  • Establish consistent standards, certification, and career pathing so SEs anywhere in the world operate at the same bar.

  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, and collaborative deal support across regions and time zones.

2. Geospatial & Technical Depth

  • Serve as the most senior technical authority in the sales organization on Earth Observation, remote sensing, GIS, and satellite analytics, and translate that expertise into customer-facing value.

  • Own the technical narrative for complex RFPs/RFIs, enterprise architecture discussions, and system integrations (GIS, EAM, ERP, SCADA/OMS/DMS).

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to represent field and customer technical requirements back into the roadmap.

  • Personally engage on the company's largest, most technically complex, or highest-visibility opportunities, including large enterprise accounts.

3. MEDDPICC & Value Selling

  • Embed and continuously improve MEDDPICC qualification discipline across the global SE team, in lockstep with Sales leadership.

  • Own the SE contribution to the Value Framework, Deal Sheets, ROI modeling, and Champion Building processes; make quantified business cases the default, not the exception.

  • Coach SEs and AEs on champions, economic buyer engagement, decision-criteria influence, and competitive positioning.

  • Track and report qualification quality and value-selling maturity as a leading indicator of pipeline health.

4. Customer Advocacy

  • Act as the voice of the customer inside LiveEO — ensuring product, delivery, and pricing decisions reflect real technical and operational realities in the field.

  • Build senior technical relationships with strategic accounts and act as an executive technical sponsor on flagship and expansion deals.

  • Champion customer success stories and reference-ability back into sales and marketing.

5. Cross-Functional & Executive Leadership

  • Partner with the VP Pre-Sales & Professional Services, VP Sales, CRO, RevOps, Product, and Customer Success on GTM strategy, forecasting, and territory/resourcing planning for the global SE function.

  • Partner with the Directors of product to provide field feedback to help drive the product roadmap forward.

  • Represent Sales Engineering in executive and board-level reporting on pipeline quality, win rates, and technical risk.

  • Own SE playbooks, demo environments, and enablement content in partnership with RevOps and Product Marketing.


Your profile

  • 8+ years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or technical pre-sales, including 4+ years leading distributed/global teams across multiple regions and time zones.

  • Enterprise experience, a demonstrated track record selling to and supporting complex enterprise accounts with multiple stakeholders and long, technical sales cycles.

  • Strong working knowledge of geospatial and remote sensing technologies, satellite/Earth Observation imagery, GIS, spatial analytics with the ability to speak credibly to technical buyers.

  • Experience with software-enabled services business models.

  • Demonstrated track record embedding MEDDPICC (or a comparable qualification framework) and quantitative value-selling/ROI methodology across a sales organization.

  • Proven customer advocacy, building trusted relationships with senior technical and business stakeholders at enterprise accounts.

  • Strong executive communication skills; comfortable operating with CRO/VP-level leadership and in board-level reporting.

  • Experience recruiting, coaching, and developing Sales Engineers and/or SE managers.

  • Experience scaling a pre-sales organization inside a high-growth (Series B/C) startup.

  • Willingness to travel globally (~30–40%).

  • Based in or near a LiveEO hub (Germany, UK, or US).

  • Experience selling SaaS/AI/analytics solutions into utilities, energy, oil & gas/midstream, rail, or supply chain/EUDR-compliance markets is a plus.

  • Familiarity with enterprise system integrations (EAM, ERP, SCADA/OMS/DMS, mobile workforce management) is a plus.

  • Familiar with product driven and tech enables services engineering organizations is a plus.


Your Benefits

  • The opportunity to create a product that can improve business processes and lives across the globe.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work model - we trust our employees to get their work done while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

  • We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.

  • Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.

  • A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons.

  • Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.

  • A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities.

  • Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.

  • Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, corporate pension program.

Adsquare's mission is centered on:

  • Passion: Solving complex challenges with exceptional people, technology, and data.

Our work is guided by our core values, and we look for candidates who embody them:

  • Drive: Turning ambition into action that brings valuable outcomes.

  • No BS: Upholding honesty, transparency, and clear communication.

  • Humble: Valuing modesty and letting results speak for themselves.

  • Moral Compass: Acting with fairness, integrity, and respect.


About the team

You'll join Adsquare's Data Products team, responsible for the pipelines and signals that power our Location Intelligence solutions. Working closely with our Lead PM for Data Products and a squad of data engineers, you'll help ingest, process, and scale the supplier and panel data that fuels our products. Your squad sits at the intersection of engineering, data governance, and downstream teams like Measurement and Activation, ensuring the signals we deliver are fast, reliable, and trustworthy.


Your Mission

As Product Owner for SDV Data Products (f/m/d), you'll own your squad's delivery, turning strategy into clear, testable backlog items while managing the technical scale of our core data pipelines. You'll be the primary technical counterpart to our data suppliers and panel partners, driving the operational reliability that keeps our signals fresh and trusted.


Your Profile

  • 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or technical PM, ideally in AdTech, MarTech, or another data-heavy ecosystem.

  • Strong at managing delivery and technical scale: sequencing complex backend work, mapping dependencies, and scoping against time, whether working with engineers, architects, or integration teams.

  • Operationally rigorous: comfortable thinking in SLIs, SLOs, freshness, match rate, and MTTR, not just features shipped, and skilled at running a tight, testable backlog.

  • Data-fluent, with required SQL proficiency: able to independently query internal data sources to investigate supplier data, panel quality, and pipeline KPIs, and bring quantified evidence into prioritisation.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to make decisions with limited information and translate business intent clearly for engineering.

  • A privacy-aware product thinker who understands data governance and how evolving privacy frameworks affect upstream ingestion and pipeline logic.

jobs.title: Senior Producer
jobs.description:
Senior Producer

ScapeWorld Entertainment

Remote. Our working day runs on CET, wherever you sit. Full time, on a long-term contract. Starting as soon as you can. Where you live while you do is up to you; the location field on this posting only fits one country, so please read this as the real rule and apply from wherever you are.

About us

We are Scape, a Swedish game studio of about 30 people, fully remote by choice. We are launching Scape on Steam Early Access later this year: a growing platform of multiplayer games where a player's identity carries across all of them. The first game inside Scape is Gravity: a precision climbing game where 100 players share one server, one tower, and one long way down. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios, Epic and Ubisoft.

Since we are a small team about to put our first game in front of players, we are looking for the person who holds the plan, the priorities and the team together while we do it. If that sounds like you, we would love to meet.

The role

Let us start with the studio you would be joining. Around thirty people, fully remote, and a group of strong leads in design, art, engineering, QA, community and commercial who own their crafts and run their own teams. What we do not have is the person who looks across all of them at once, holds the plan they are all working to, and makes the day-to-day calls that keep it moving as one. That is this role. It is the only production seat in the company, and it comes with real authority.

You would work closely with the Creative Director. They own what the game is, set the direction and make the big bets. You own the plan that gets us there and the decisions inside it: scope, sequencing and trade-offs within a milestone are yours to make, and you decide which questions need to reach them and which do not. They should be able to step back and know that things are being handled, because they are.

In practice, it comes down to four things:

You know how a game gets made. You can see what depends on what, where the effort really sits, and whether an estimate is going to hold. When a lead tells you how long something takes, you know how to hear it and what has to land for the work to ship on time.

You own the plan and the priorities. Not just the schedule, but the order of work behind it. When two things compete, you decide, or you get the decision made and tell everyone affected. Open questions have an owner and a date. Nothing sits unanswered because nobody was sure whose call it was.

You plan ahead. Problems get found while they are still cheap, and everything that has to land together lands together: builds, assets, store material, localization, press dates.

You lead the team's delivery. People know the plan is real, feel good about hitting it, and are still standing when it ships. The leads lead their crafts. You lead how it all comes together, and you meet each team where it is: some want you in the weeds with them on estimates and sequencing, others mainly need the picture across teams kept current. You read which is which.

We have a production pipeline that works, and like any pipeline it can always be better. You would inherit it as it is, get to know it and the people who run it, and then improve it where you see the need. Nobody here expects you to arrive with all the answers. We do hope you arrive curious about how we work and comfortable telling us, kindly and clearly, where we could do better.


What you will own

  • Production priorities day to day: the order of work across the studio, the trade-off calls within a milestone, and every open question that is blocking someone. You find who can answer, get it answered or escalated with a clear recommendation attached, and close the loop with the teams waiting on it. If a question is blocking someone, it is yours until it is not

  • Keeping design, art, engineering, QA and marketing in step with each other, week by week, so nobody is working against a version of the plan that has moved

  • The forward view: every feature in flight, what each one is still waiting on, the handoffs between departments caught early, and risk seen while it is still cheap, named, and carrying a mitigation before it turns into a schedule event

  • The team's delivery health: sustainable pace, morale, and delivery on target, treated as one problem rather than a trade-off

  • Marketing as a real production dependency, and the alignment dates around release: builds, assets, store material, localization drops, press dates, landing on time and together

  • The production plan behind all of it: a milestone schedule with a baseline, a forecast per milestone from velocity against remaining scope, estimates held against actuals, and replanning on a cycle rather than after something breaks

  • QA in step with everyone else. Our QA lead owns testing; you make sure QA knows what is coming and when, that testable builds land when the plan says they do, and that the QA window sits in the schedule where it belongs rather than where it ends up

  • External production partners: localization, video, 3D, anything we outsource. You own the relationship and the communication in both directions, and you chase. Briefs and context going out, deliveries coming in and landing in the build, and the schedule that keeps them in step with everyone else. Leads should never have to chase a partner themselves. The craft stays with the partner; making it fit is on you

  • The production process itself and the tools it runs through. We use Jira, including Jira Plans for planning months out against a baseline, and you own it for the studio. You also support hiring managers through their recruitment processes, so a lead who is hiring can focus on assessing the person rather than running the process


You

Most people who can do this job have around five years in games production behind them. Take that as a description of who tends to apply, not a bar we hold. If you can show us the things below with less, please apply anyway. We would rather meet you than miss you.

  • You know how games get made across disciplines: what waits on what, how long things really take, and where a plan is optimistic before the dates say so

  • You have produced across several titles and taken at least one PC title all the way to release, including the closing stretch: feature lock, bug burn, submission, the go decision. Which store matters less than that you have been through a PC launch. Projects that were cancelled along the way still count; we know how the last few years have gone for a lot of good people

  • You have owned priorities, not just a schedule. You have made cut-or-keep calls on a shipped title and lived with them, and you can tell us about one you got wrong

  • You have worked closely with a founder, studio head or creative director, and you know how to take decisions off their plate without going around them

  • You have built and driven a schedule, and you have written down a way of working that other people picked up and used. We would love to see examples, in whatever form they exist

  • You have led a team to a target without burning it out, and the people on it would work with you again

  • You are proactive by default and you work independently. You do not wait to be asked or chased; given an assignment, you find out what it needs and finish it well without someone checking each step. That is what senior means to us

  • Leads tell you how things are really going, because you talk with them directly and they trust you with the real picture

  • You are fluent in Jira at the level of owning it for a team, Jira Plans included. It is a tool, not the job, but it is the tool we run the plan through, so we need you good with it

  • You work our day, which runs on CET; where you sit while you do is up to you. And you are comfortable working in English, written and spoken


Helpful, not required

  • Steam specifically: Steamworks, builds and depots, the store page, review and submission, and how Early Access behaves through the whole run

  • Live operations and a patch cadence

  • Working with external production partners before, on either side of the relationship

  • Time at a small studio where you were the only producer, or where the producer and product owner were the same person

  • A remote-first team


What we offer

The whole project and the authority that comes with it. Real decisions, not just a schedule to report against. Strong leads beside you rather than under you, and a Creative Director who wants to hand things over and means it. A company small enough that what you do is visible in what we ship, and people who will notice.

We are a self-motivated team, remote by choice and flexible in how we work, and we run on people helping each other rather than watching each other. Everyone here is trusted to own their part and supported when they need a hand, and we would like that to be true for you from your first week.

And we are early. Scape is heading to Steam with everything still ahead of it. Joining now means building something with a real chance of becoming big, and being one of the people it belongs to when it does.


Practical

  • Remote. Our working day runs on CET and this role keeps it.

  • Full time, on a long-term contract.

  • Start: as soon as you can. Tell us your notice period in the application form and we will work around it.

  • Recruitment is ongoing.

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments.

We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today.


About the team

STARK's maritime division is at the forefront of autonomous surface and subsea innovation. We are building the next generation of modular, sensor-integrated maritime platforms designed to dominate in complex, contested environments. You will work closely with cross-functional teams of systems engineers, naval architects, and software developers to bridge the gap between cutting-edge engineering and operational deployment. Our team values rapid iteration, technical rigour, and a bias for action in everything we build.


Your mission

As Product Manager for Maritime, you own the development of STARK’s software-defined maritime capabilities and complex sensor suites. You will direct the integration of these systems by driving high-tempo collaboration with System Engineering, Project Delivery, and Operations teams. Your mission is to translate tactical operational requirements into dominant, mass-scalable platforms that ensure NATO maritime superiority.


Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end development of software-defined maritime capabilities and mission-critical sensor suites.

  • Direct the integration of advanced sensors and autonomous software by leading collaboration across System Engineering, Project Delivery, and Operations teams.

  • Drive product testing strategies—including Software-in-the-Loop (SITL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL), and full hardware/software integrations—in lockstep with System Engineering, Project Delivery, and Operations teams.

  • Lead strategic market analysis to identify and capture platform opportunities for NATO allied forces.

  • Manage the complete product lifecycle from prototype to deployment and customer acceptance.

  • Enforce rigorous safety and compliance standards across the maritime product portfolio.

  • Communicate product vision and strategic milestones to internal stakeholders and external defence partners.


Qualifications

  • Technical degree (e.g. Maritime/Systems Engineering, CS) or equivalent experience.

  • Experience in product management delivering complex maritime/defence systems.

  • Understanding of maritime operations and sensor integration.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and navigate regulatory requirements.

  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain a UK security clearance.


Nice to have

  • Experience with naval projects or autonomous/robotic platforms.

  • Background in defence-tech or rapid-growth aerospace.

  • Experience working in a V-model while maintaining agile development pace.

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, reliability, and security. You’ll work across our platform to improve how we operate production systems, strengthen our security practices, and give engineers the tooling and infrastructure they need to ship quickly and confidently.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys working across boundaries, takes ownership, and brings a pragmatic approach to solving problems. You don’t need to be an expert in every part of our stack, but you should be excited to learn, move quickly, and make an impact.

  • Improve our observability practices and help engineers understand, debug, and operate systems in production

  • Partner across engineering and security to strengthen our cloud security posture and operational practices

  • Thrives in a fast-moving environment where ownership, curiosity, and pragmatic decision-making matter

The stack

  • Security & compliance: Vanta, Socket

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Argo CD

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Neo4j, Snowflake

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

Location: Remote, preference for Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain or Portugal. Key engineering and product teams are based in these locales.

The Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer on the Product Engineering team, you'll design and deliver high impact features, working closely with product, design, and other engineers to solve complex problems, build scalable solutions, and ensure our systems are maintainable and performant.

You’ll take ownership of projects from concept to production, contribute to architectural decisions, write high quality code, and help raise the technical bar by sharing knowledge and best practices with your teammates.

You'll work on:

  • Building elegant features for user researchers to analyze and extract compelling insights from qualitative data, using both classical techniques and large language models

  • Expanding audience management to help researchers connect with and reward participants from across the world

  • Integrating video and scheduling tools to provide a streamlined experience for managing and booking user interviews

As a product engineer at Maze, you will:

  • Partner closely with product managers, designers and other engineers to design, build, and ship new features

  • Establish best practices, frameworks, and repeatable processes that enable us to measure the impact of every feature that we ship

  • Evaluate and improve the performance, maintainability, and security of applications in production

  • Work in a collaborative and open team, which places high value on feedback, continuous learning and trust.

You should apply if:

  • You're proficient with modern full-stack JavaScript (Node.js and React) and relational databases (PostgreSQL)

  • You're enthusiastic about well-tested code and strive to improve your work environment

  • You have excellent written and spoken English skills

  • You thrive in a remote environment

Bonus points:

  • You have Next.js, NestJS, GraphQL, and/or TypeScript experience

  • You have experience with AWS and/or Kubernetes

  • You're interested in UX, UI design, and the research field

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture. 

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package.

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

Why Maze is unique

  • Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze.

  • Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge.

  • Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions

Benefits

  • Health insurance with international coverage, vision, and dental: 100% of the team member premium paid

    • For some locations, coverage options vary, please see our benefits pages for more information

  • Free access to proper mental health care, unlimited virtual therapy sessions (with a human) and 24/7 access to resources

  • Life and Disability Insurance, 100% of the team member premium paid

  • Flexible time off

  • Meaningful equity

  • Company retreats, fully paid for by Maze

  • New MacBook (laptop), paid for by Maze

  • Paid Family leave: 16 weeks for birth or adoptive parents

  • $500/month to be used for dependent health insurance coverage

    • If you don't have dependents to add to your plan, you will still get access to this money to be used at your discretion to get the benefits that matter to you with our flexible a-maze-ing benefits - gym memberships, co-working spaces, food, travel, whatever!

  • $1,500 remote work setup fund to ensure you can set up a productive work space

  • Flexible work schedule where you manage your own working hours

  • Monthly Bonus.ly points that are awarded to others to recognize teamwork, dedication and helpfulness - points can be cashed out for gift cards and more

  • Virtual social engagements randomly throughout the year

  • SWAG, we have some really cool swag

  • Open, transparent culture that includes virtual: coffee chats, bi-weekly all-hands meetings, and more

Check out all of our a-maze-ing benefits here. 

Outreach Notice

We understand you might be excited about the job you’re applying for, we are excited you are interested! However, please refrain from reaching out to our current team members on LinkedIn for referrals. Our policy is that referrals can only be provided by team members who personally know the candidate. With the high volume of interest in our roles, contacting our team members who are not involved in recruitment can be overwhelming. Additionally, please avoid submitting support tickets regarding your application, as our support team is not involved in the hiring process. Rest assured, our recruitment team is diligently reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if there is a match.

The foundation is already in place: customers love the product, relationships are strong, and commercial results speak for themselves. HEADLINE:

Reporting to: Chief Commercial Officer
Location: London - Hybrid-Working: 3 days in office, 2 days from home

ABOUT THE ROLE:
APEXX is pioneering payment orchestration, transforming the global payments landscape with cutting-edge technology and innovation. As a leader in Fintech, we're committed to excellence, driving forward-thinking solutions that empower businesses worldwide.

We are looking for an experienced VP of Partnerships to lead APEXX's global partnerships strategy and drive sustainable revenue growth through strategic alliances across the payments ecosystem.

This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for identifying, negotiating and growing commercial partnerships that expand APEXX's market reach, strengthen our product offering and create new revenue opportunities. You will own relationships with payment providers, acquiring banks, card schemes, financial institutions, and strategic industry stakeholders, ensuring APEXX continues to build a best-in-class global payments network.

Reporting directly to the CCO, you will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing and Customer Success to develop partnership strategies that accelerate customer acquisition, increase transaction volume and support APEXX's international growth ambitions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Strategy & Partner Enablement:

  • Develop and execute APEXX's global partnerships strategy, aligned with the company's commercial objectives and growth plans.

  • Identify strategic opportunities that drive recurring revenue growth, expand market reach and strengthen APEXX's competitive position.

  • Build and maintain an ecosystem of high-value partnerships that support long-term business growth.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the COO and Executive Leadership Team on partnership strategy, market opportunities and industry trends.

Revenue Growth:

  • Deliver measurable commercial outcomes through strategic partnerships that generate new revenue streams and increase payment volumes.

  • Identify, negotiate and execute commercial agreements that create mutual value for APEXX and its partners.

  • Collaborate closely with Sales and Commercial teams to develop partner-led growth initiatives and joint go-to-market programmes.

  • Create scalable partnership models that accelerate customer acquisition and market expansion.

Partner Relationship Management:

  • Own executive relationships with acquirers, banks, payment schemes, alternative payment providers, fintechs and strategic technology partners.

  • Represent APEXX at executive meetings, industry forums, conferences and customer engagements.

  • Strengthen APEXX's reputation within the global payments community and identify opportunities to influence industry direction.

  • Lead complex commercial negotiations with senior stakeholders across global organisations.

Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Partner with Product leadership to shape the strategic roadmap based on market demand and partner capabilities.

  • Work closely with Engineering and Delivery teams to prioritise integrations that maximise commercial value.

  • Collaborate with Marketing on joint campaigns, thought leadership and co-marketing initiatives.

  • Ensure partnerships deliver measurable business outcomes through effective governance, performance tracking and continuous optimisation.

Market & Industry Leadership:

  • Monitor market developments, competitive activity, regulatory changes and emerging payment technologies.

  • Identify opportunities for new strategic alliances, product innovation and international expansion.

  • Provide market intelligence and commercial insight to influence business strategy and investment priorities.

ABOUT YOU:

  • Significant leadership experience in strategic partnerships, business development or commercial leadership within Payments, FinTech or Financial Services.

  • Proven track record of delivering revenue growth through strategic partnerships and commercial alliances.

  • Deep understanding of the global payments ecosystem, including acquiring, orchestration, card schemes, alternative payment methods and financial infrastructure.

  • Strong executive network across banks, payment providers, fintechs, technology partners and industry organisations.

  • Demonstrated success negotiating complex, high-value commercial agreements with enterprise organisations.

  • Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen and the ability to translate partnerships into measurable business outcomes.

  • Exceptional executive presence with outstanding communication, influencing and negotiation skills.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales and Executive Leadership teams.

  • Strong analytical capability and the ability to identify emerging market opportunities.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

Great people deserve great rewards. We believe in recognising the impact you make with competitive compensation and benefits that support you both at work and beyond.

Whether it's taking time to recharge, looking after your health, working from somewhere new, or investing in your growth, we've built a benefits package designed to help you thrive, because when our people do well, so does APEXX.

💰 Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries that recognise your skills, experience, and the impact you make.

🏖️ Generous Time Off: Take the time you need to rest and recharge with annual leave, public holidays, and wellbeing-focused time away from work.

🌍 Work From Anywhere: Enjoy the flexibility to work remotely from eligible locations for up to 90 days per year, subject to our Work From Anywhere policy.*

❤️ Comprehensive Health Insurance: Your wellbeing matters. We provide comprehensive health insurance which includes optical & dental to help support you when it matters most.

🛡️ Life Insurance & Critical Illness Protection: Additional protection for you and your loved ones when it’s needed most.

👶 Enhanced Family Leave: Supporting you through life's biggest milestones with enhanced parental and family-friendly leave policies.

📈 Learning & Growth: We're invested in your development, with opportunities to learn, grow, and build a meaningful career at APEXX.

WHO WE ARE & WHERE WE ARE:

APEXX is a global payment orchestration platform with teams across the UK & India, helping enterprise businesses simplify the complexity of payments. For more than a decade, we've been building technology that enables merchants to connect to the world's payment ecosystem through a single, scalable integration.

Our platform gives businesses access to 200+ acquirers, 150+ alternative payment methods, and 10+ Buy Now, Pay Later providers, helping them optimise payment performance, improve acceptance rates, and expand into new markets with confidence.

Trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon, and Jet2, we're redefining enterprise payments by making them smarter, faster, and more reliable.

As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities to make an impact. Whether you're building products, solving complex engineering challenges, or supporting the teams behind them, you'll play a meaningful role in shaping the future of global payments at APEXX.
