jobs.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’ collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

Superhuman is on a mission to build the fastest, most delightful productivity experiences powered by AI. As we scale rapidly, our internal technology operations must evolve to match our ambition.

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to join our Corporate Technology team. Our commitment to user trust is unwavering, and this new team member will play a crucial role in protecting Superhuman’s corporate environment and the infrastructure that millions of users depend on. Working closely with the Corporate Infrastructure team, you will harden and secure the systems our employees rely on every day, Identity and Access Management, Endpoint Management, SaaS platforms, and Networking, while ensuring that security enables speed rather than slowing it down.

This is an opportunity to build and maintain critical security programs, including Insider Risk, Threat and Vulnerability Management, and Third-Party Risk. You’ll leverage AI to build smarter security controls and processes, and help define how AI itself is secured across our corporate infrastructure. Your work will empower employees to move fast while maintaining a high bar for corporate security.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and maintain corporate security controls that enable employees to move fast with confidence, making the secure path the easiest path.

  • Develop security standards, guidelines, and policies in collaboration with the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team.

  • Leverage AI to build and scale security controls, automate security processes, and accelerate threat detection and response across our corporate infrastructure.

  • Define and implement AI security standards for the corporate environment, ensuring employees can safely adopt AI-powered tools and workflows.

  • Perform risk assessments and security assurance on systems that support Superhuman’s business operations: IdP, operating systems, desktop applications, SaaS solutions, and network infrastructure (ZTNA, CASB, VPN).

  • Lead the design and execution of a corporate Zero Trust architecture, working across identity, endpoint, and network security.

  • Drive the remediation of security vulnerabilities identified through assessments.

  • Evaluate and implement cutting-edge enterprise security technology to continuously strengthen our security posture.

Qualifications

  • Has 6+ years of experience working on a Security team in corporate security, enterprise security, or a related domain for a SaaS company.

  • Expert-level understanding and experience in at least two corporate security domains: Identity and Access Management, Endpoint Management, SaaS platforms, and Networking.

  • Strong experience with data protection technologies (DSPM, discovery, masking, access controls, DLP, backup).

  • Strong experience with assessing the configuration of common SaaS applications (SSPM), such as Salesforce, Workday, Coupa.

  • Strong experience with both MacOS and Windows endpoint security.

  • Familiarity with AI security principles and practical knowledge of how to secure AI adoption in a corporate environment.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI to build security controls, automate security processes, or scale security operations.

  • Ability to assess risk in ambiguous situations and make balanced security decisions that consider both offensive and defensive perspectives.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and manage up effectively.

  • A mindset that security should enable speed, experience designing controls that protect without creating unnecessary friction.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional Growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first, hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our team member resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations—to apply. Superhuman is an equal opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, sexual identity, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, criminal prosecution, judgment in a criminal case, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Codex)
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Applied AI Engineering team is responsible for helping customers turn frontier AI capabilities into real products, workflows, and business impact. We act as trusted technical partners across solution design, architecture, implementation, evaluation, and adoption, working alongside customers to build and scale effective AI applications with OpenAI’s technologies.

The Codex Applied AI Engineering team focuses on helping organizations transform how software is built with AI. We partner directly with engineering teams and technical leaders to integrate Codex into their software development lifecycle — from identifying high-impact use cases and designing AI-enabled workflows to implementation, evaluation, and scaled adoption. Our work helps ensure AI-powered software development is effective, reliable, secure, and deeply integrated into how engineering organizations operate.


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced technical leader to join as Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Codex), leading a team of Applied AI Engineers responsible for driving successful Codex adoption across strategic customers. Your team will work hands-on with customer engineering organizations to design and build AI-enabled development workflows, solve complex implementation challenges, and establish scalable patterns for AI-powered software development.

As a manager, you will shape how these technical engagements operate at scale — setting strategy, coaching engineers, determining where the team can have the greatest impact, and ensuring consistently strong execution across customers. You will serve as both a people leader and senior technical advisor, partnering closely with Sales, Product, Research, and Engineering to translate customer needs and real-world usage into better technical approaches, reusable patterns, and product insights.

Success in this role will be measured by meaningful and sustained Codex adoption, successful customer outcomes, and the creation of repeatable technical patterns that help engineering organizations get more value from AI.

This role is open in our Munich and Berlin offices. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.


In This Role, You Will

  • Lead, hire, and mentor a high-performing team of Applied AI Engineers supporting Codex customers across strategic accounts.

  • Own the operating model and technical engagement strategy for Codex Applied AI Engineering, helping customers move from initial exploration to meaningful, scaled adoption.

  • Guide teams in designing and implementing AI-enhanced development workflows, agentic systems, automations, evaluations, and scalable application architectures.

  • Act as the senior technical escalation point and thought partner for complex customer implementations and engineering challenges.

  • Partner with Sales, Product, Research, and Engineering teams to align customer outcomes with product direction and roadmap priorities.

  • Establish repeatable technical patterns, playbooks, reference architectures, and best practices that enable broader adoption of AI-powered software development.

  • Coach Applied AI Engineers to operate as trusted technical partners to engineering leaders, executives, and highly technical customer teams.

  • Synthesize insights from customer engagements and translate them into actionable feedback for Product, Research, and Engineering.

  • Develop a deep understanding of how customers are using Codex, where they encounter friction, and where new technical approaches or product capabilities could unlock greater impact.

  • Champion safe, reliable, and effective adoption of AI-powered development workflows across industries.


You’ll Thrive in This Role If You

  • Have 8+ years of experience in deeply technical, customer-facing roles such as applied engineering, solutions architecture, deployment engineering, technical consulting, or similar roles.

  • Have 2+ years of experience leading technical teams, including hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers.

  • Have experience building or deploying generative AI, developer platforms, agentic systems, or cloud-based software solutions in production environments.

  • Possess strong hands-on software engineering experience and fluency with programming languages such as Python or JavaScript.

  • Understand modern software development lifecycles and have strong intuition for how AI and coding agents can change how software is designed, built, tested, and maintained.

  • Can work directly with customer engineering teams to understand ambiguous problems, develop technical approaches, and turn ideas into working solutions.

  • Are an effective communicator who can translate complex technical and business topics for both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.

  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and enjoy building new operating models, technical patterns, and teams from first principles.

  • Demonstrate strong ownership, humility, technical judgment, and a commitment to helping both customers and teammates succeed.

  • Are personally committed to fostering the safe and beneficial development of AI.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

Deployment strategist
jobs.description:
About Seamflow

We’re removing one of the last great barriers to progress in the physical world. While software moves fast, industries like healthcare, aerospace, and energy are still slowed by outdated, manual systems.

Our vision is to unlock enormous value for Testing, Inspection, and Certification customers globally. The market is vast, the problem is real, and we're just getting started.

We're rapidly growing following our 14x oversubscribed $4.5M seed round backed by Tier 1 investors including Northzone and Initialized Capital. These funds backed the founders of Coinbase, Reddit, Klarna, and Spotify.

We're seeing significant traction in the market; demand is outstripping our supply, and we're building fast to keep up.

 

The Team

Our team includes AI researchers from world-leading academic institutions like Johns Hopkins, MIPT, and UCL, former founding engineers at unicorn startups, and alumni of X, Google, Amazon, and Yandex, alongside former leaders from McKinsey and Bain. We look for people who move fast, think clearly, and hold themselves to a high bar. The standard here is genuinely high, and we're looking for someone who raises it further.

 

The Role

As a Deployment Strategist, you'll own our client deployments end to end: from the moment a pilot is signed to the moment the client can't imagine working without us. You'll embed with customers, map their workflows, configure Seamflow around those workflows, and drive adoption. You'll partner closely with the founding team, sales, engineering, and the customer.

We're looking for someone who combines consulting-grade structure with genuine curiosity. You're great with people and build trust quickly, whether you're in a room with a frontline reviewer or a VP. You operate independently, take ownership without waiting to be told, and bring an entrepreneurial instinct to every account. Every successful deployment is a reference account that unlocks the next deployments.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own deployments: Design and run structured deployment plans for enterprise pilots, breaking ambiguous client problems into clear milestones, owners, and deadlines.

  • Define our deployment strategy: As one of our first deployment hires, you'll define how Seamflow deploys. You won't just execute a playbook, you'll write it.

  • Build the team beneath you: You'll support hiring and shape the deployment function as it scales, turning yourself from an individual operator into the leader of a function.

  • Map workflows: Go deep into testing, inspection and certification environments. You will need to understand the customer's documents, systems, and pain points, and translate that into how we configure and improve the product.

  • Drive adoption: Build trust with senior stakeholders, identify champions, remove blockers, and make sure the people doing the work actually use the tool.

  • Feed the product: Work closely with engineering to turn what you learn in the field into product requirements.

     

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5 years (junior manager or above) in consulting, customer-facing deployment or implementation roles, or operational roles in enterprise B2B.

  • AI-native: You already run your work through AI and operate at 10x as a result. You reach for these tools by default, not as a novelty, and you're constantly finding new ways to compress what used to take days into hours.

  • Structured and organised: you can run multiple workstreams across multiple clients without dropping anything.

  • High emotional intelligence: comfortable in a room with an EVP in the morning and a technical reviewer in the afternoon, and able to win the trust of both.

  • Fast learner with real intellectual curiosity.

  • Bias to action: you'd rather ship a good plan today than a perfect one next week.

  • Strong with slides, Excel, and written communication.

  • Willing to travel to client sites across Europe when deployments need it.

  • Someone who wants to be in the room, not on a call. This role is in-person, full time at our Shoreditch office.

  • Nice to have: European languages

     

What You’ll Get

  • A huge amount of responsibility and trust from day one, with the autonomy to run your deployments your way

  • The opportunity to define a function and grow a team beneath you as we scale

  • Competitive compensation package including equity and a performance-based bonus

  • Hands-on exposure to every part of building a business

  • A team that moves fast, works hard, and backs each other fully

  • Competitive compensation package

  • Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, relocation support if needed

jobs.title: Staff Data Analyst
jobs.description:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

The Role

We're hiring a Staff Data Analyst.

This is not a reporting-only role. Embedded day to day within our commercial team, you'll be responsible for the core metrics that matter to the business - conversion rate, contracted volume, total sales, and margins - building on the pipeline tracking, forecasting and partner reporting that already exists. Priorities are set jointly with commercial; performance and development sit with the Analytics Manager, who you'll report into.

As a senior analyst, you'll take ambiguous commercial questions, decide the right approach, and turn analysis into clear recommendations rather than just presenting numbers. Success isn't measured by dashboards shipped - it's measured by whether stakeholders have metrics they understand and trust, analysis that changes what people do, and a team that can increasingly self-serve the answers it needs.

Responsibilities

Pipeline & Revenue Forecasting Accuracy

  • Monitor the sales pipeline, catching and resolving cases where in-progress and confirmed revenue overlap or deals get double-counted.

  • Define and report on forecast accuracy against annual targets, setting the standard for how commercial metrics are tracked across the team.

  • Diagnose CRM data quality issues, such as parent-child asset relationships, that put pipeline and forecast reliability at risk.

Commercial Analysis & Insight

  • Carry out commercial opportunity sizing and partner performance analysis to support sales and leadership decisions.

  • Identify underperformance, emerging trends and risks in the pipeline before they surface in headline forecast numbers.

  • Serve as the voice of data for the commercial team, translating complex analysis, including retention and renewal trends, into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.

Partnership & Storytelling

  • Work directly with commercial and sales stakeholders to understand what "good" looks like for their metrics, and translate that into clear, agreed definitions.

  • Translate complex data into clear, compelling stories that inspire action among non-technical stakeholders.

  • Increase data adoption across the commercial team so non-technical colleagues can self-serve for routine needs.

Requirements

Must haves

  • Solid SQL skills, used to investigate complex datasets across modern analytics stacks (e.g. dbt, Omni or similar BI tools).

  • Good commercial understanding, with an ability to connect analytical findings to revenue and margin outcomes.

  • Experience developing forecasts or scenario models, and explaining the drivers behind variance from actuals.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous stakeholder questions into well-defined analytical problems, and to present recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.

  • Proven experience building trusted metrics or reporting from messy or inconsistent source data (e.g. CRM, transactional systems).

Bonus points

  • Experience in energy, fintech, or another commercially complex, data-heavy sector.

  • Python for deeper statistical or data-quality work.

  • Experience building metric frameworks that connect operational activity to commercial outcomes.

  • Familiarity with CRM systems and parent-child/account hierarchy data structures.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary of £92,500 - 101,000GBP (or equivalent in your local currency)

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first within the UK and EU.

Interview Process

  • Intro call with Talent, 30 minutes.

  • Behavioural Interview with the Hiring Manager, 60 minutes.

  • Technical Skills interview with the team, 60 minutes.

  • Bar Raiser interview with leadership stakeholders, 45 minutes.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

Compensation: £92.5K – £101K • Offers Equity

The Role

We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer.

Data sits at the core of what tem does. Our time-series data is the spine that runs from pricing through to billing: every transaction depends on it working. You'll be working across a genuinely varied set of workloads: textual data, time-series data, and event streams, each with its own ingestion and reliability challenges, including TSDS.

You'll join our Data Service team of 4, owning the design, reliability, and recovery strategy of specific ingestion pipelines and systems end-to-end. This is an individual contributor role: no team to manage, full ownership of the work you do. The team has more work than hands right now, and this role exists to close that gap so the business can move faster on the data it depends on.

You'll also work closely with our AI initiatives as they grow: the platform you own increasingly becomes the foundation those efforts depend on.

You will:

  • Own the design, reliability, and recovery strategy for the ingestion pipelines and systems in your domain.

  • Maintain and improve the data platform, including working through the existing tech debt backlog.

  • Build monitoring and alerting so issues surface before they become incidents.

  • Set the data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them.

  • Help take the number of data products with a defined SLA from 2 to 10.

Responsibilities

Data Ingestion

  • Own the design, reliability, and resilience of ingestion pipelines end-to-end, including TSDS, with a clear recovery strategy when things break.

  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines for new and existing data sources.

  • Decide the right approach (batch vs. streaming) for each pipeline in your domain, including high-scale, low-latency requirements for time-series data.

  • Set data quality checks that make an SLA commitment possible, and hold the line on them.

Platform Maintenance

  • Own the day-to-day reliability of the data platform: monitoring, testing, and fixing issues before they become firefights.

  • Own code quality and standards for the systems you're responsible for, including CI checks (linting, tests, coverage).

  • Work through the existing tech debt backlog, prioritising fixes that unblock SLA commitments.

  • Optimise pipelines for performance and cost as data volumes grow.

  • Handle the failure modes specific to energy data: late arrivals, reprocessing, backfills.

Monitoring & Alerting

  • Build and improve observability across your systems so problems surface before they cause downstream impact.

  • Set up alerting tied to the SLAs the team is committing to.

  • Investigate and resolve issues within your domain, escalating genuinely cross-system problems.

Supporting Expansion

  • Help scope and prepare the platform for new data sources tied to international expansion.

  • Flag where current architecture won't hold up as scope grows, even if fixing it isn't your call to make alone.

  • Work closely with the AI team as their data needs on the platform grow.

Requirements

Must haves

  • Strong Python skills, with proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.

  • Experience owning the design, reliability, and resilience of a data pipeline or system end-to-end, not just writing pipeline code.

  • AWS or GCP experience.

  • Great communication skills, comfortable working directly with stakeholders to scope and agree SLAs, and explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences.

  • Strong team player, comfortable working independently against a backlog and making judgement calls on prioritisation, while fitting into an existing team of 4.

  • Terraform experience.

Bonus points

  • Experience with time-series data at scale.

  • Experience with modern data stack tooling (Airflow, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, ClickHouse).

  • Experience in energy or climate tech.

  • Background in high-growth startups or scale-ups.

  • Genuine interest in how AI tooling and workflows intersect with data engineering.

We're open to someone who doesn't tick every box here, as long as they bring solid AWS or GCP experience and the ability to own their own work end-to-end.

Benefits & Perks

  • Salary aligned to internal benchmarks and reviewed twice a year.

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

Home working and wellbeing budgets:

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR150 per month for wellbeing.

Interview Process

We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know.

  • Intro call with Talent, 30 minutes.

  • Behavioural interview, 60 minutes.

  • Skills interview with cross-functional leaders, 60 to 90 minutes, including a practical exercise.

All of it running continuously. All of it on the critical path for every deal tem closes.

Machine learning is at the heart of it. Rosso combines forecasting, optimisation and classical ML to process billions of data points and drive thousands of automated decisions a day. Every inference shapes the prices our customers see.

We've proved the concept. tem now serves 2% of the UK market. The next step is building a pricing engine that doesn't just react — one that proactively drives growth by targeting the right customers at the right time, at the right price, while protecting margin and portfolio balance. We're looking for a Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer to own pricing ML within Rosso. This is a hands-on senior IC role with real technical authority — you set the strategy, define the mathematical approach, build the models, and ship them. You work closely with MLOps and software engineers, but you don't wait on them. The hard part of this job is the formulation, not the infrastructure.

🚀 Responsibilities

  • Own the technical direction for pricing ML. Define what to build and how. Set the roadmap for the pricing engine as a core piece of tem's IP — and be accountable for its performance.

  • Formulate and solve the pricing problem properly. The mathematical foundation doesn't fully exist yet. Your first job is to define it: a dynamic, real-time system that simultaneously optimises for signing probability, portfolio balance, and margin. Choose the right approach — stochastic programming, reinforcement learning, classical ML, or a hybrid — based on the problem, not familiarity.

  • Build and ship models end-to-end. Own the modelling and data layer. Write production-grade Python. Architect models with deployment in mind and carry them through to production — you can execute without being blocked by engineering dependencies.

  • Solve imbalance problems. Develop probabilistic models to optimise risk management and short-term balancing decisions in a highly dynamic environment.

  • Be the voice of pricing ML across the business. Commercial, product, and engineering teams depend on this engine. They need to understand what it's doing and why. You make that happen — clearly, without losing precision.

  • Senior technical leadership. A track record of setting direction for a significant technical area, influencing cross-functional teams, and translating complex model behaviour into clear terms for commercial, product, and engineering stakeholders — so decisions are understood and acted on.

About you

Pennylane est une fintech française parmi les plus dynamiques du pays, actuellement en pleine expansion à l'échelle européenne.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoia, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leurs débuts

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1 000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs qui recommanderaient Pennylane à leurs proches

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail vraiment flexible

Tu rejoins l’équipe Support applicatif et technique en tant qu’expert métier et plateforme.

Tu es l’interlocuteur privilégié des dirigeants, des comptables internalisés et des cabinets d’expertise-comptable qui utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur comptabilité et leurs finances.

Au quotidien, tu analyses leurs problématiques, les accompagnes dans la résolution de leurs demandes et les aides à tirer pleinement parti de la plateforme. Tu contribues également à l’amélioration du produit en faisant remonter des retours structurés aux équipes internes.

📋 Tes missions

Support et résolution de problèmes

  • Réceptionner, qualifier et analyser les demandes des utilisateurs

  • Comprendre leur problématique et leur contexte métier

  • Apporter des réponses claires, pédagogiques et adaptées

  • Assurer le suivi des tickets jusqu’à leur résolution complète

  • Escalader les sujets complexes aux équipes techniques ou produit

  • Garantir un haut niveau de qualité de service

  • Aider les comptables en entreprise et en cabinet à intégrer leurs données dans Pennylane

  • Comprendre les enjeux liés à la migration depuis un autre logiciel comptable

  • Identifier les éventuelles difficultés et coordonner leur résolution

  • Participer à l’amélioration des processus et de la documentation associés

Amélioration continue et partage d’expertise

  • Créer et mettre à jour les supports d’aide destinés aux utilisateurs

  • Identifier les questions récurrentes et favoriser l’autonomie des clients

  • Partager tes connaissances comptables avec l’équipe

  • Faire remonter les irritants et les besoins aux équipes produit

  • Proposer des améliorations sur les process et les outils internes

🚀 Tes premiers mois chez Pennylane

Les 3 premiers mois

  • Tu suis la Pennylane Academy et te formes sur le produit et les process de l’équipe

  • Tu découvres l’entreprise, sa vision et ses différents départements

  • Tu apprends à identifier les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement

  • Tu commences à traiter des demandes liées à la comptabilité

Entre 4 et 6 mois

  • Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends en charge tes demandes de bout en bout

  • Tu traites des problématiques de plus en plus complexes

  • Tu contribues aux supports d’aide et au partage de connaissances

  • Tu deviens un relais de la voix du client auprès des équipes produit

Et ensuite

Tu deviens progressivement un expert produit et métier, capable d’identifier les axes d’amélioration et de porter des projets. Des évolutions vers des sujets Support plus complexes, la gestion de comptes ou la mise en œuvre de Pennylane sont également possibles.

  • Formation comptable : BTS CGO, DCG, BTS Assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Bachelor Responsable administratif et comptable, Master CCA ou équivalent

  • Au moins 3 ans d’expérience en cabinet d’expertise-comptable

  • Idéalement, au moins trois périodes fiscales réalisées

  • Une expérience en contact direct avec des dirigeants est un plus

  • Solides connaissances des principes comptables et de la réalité des cabinets

  • Appétence pour les outils numériques et les nouvelles technologies

  • Autonomie, curiosité et capacité à résoudre des problèmes

  • Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et pédagogie

  • Sens du service et aisance dans la relation client

  • Capacité à travailler en équipe et à s’adapter rapidement

  • Envie d’apprendre et de suivre les évolutions du produit

  • Anglais professionnel (compréhension écrite, orale et expression écrite)

  • La connaissance de Pennylane est un plus

⚙️ Le process de recrutement

  1. Un premier échange avec un recruteur, 30 minutes

  2. Un entretien et un cas pratique avec un membre de l'équipe, 1 heure

  3. Un entretien final avec la manager d'équipe, 45 minutes

  • Une mutuelle Alan Blue et Alan Mind

  • Des tickets restaurant via Swile

  • Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

  • Un budget mensuel pour travailler depuis chez toi ou dans un espace de coworking

  • Des bureaux situés à quelques minutes de Saint-Lazare, à Paris

  • Une enveloppe de BSPCE

  • Un accès à 8 000 salles de sport et plus de 300 activités bien-être via Gymlib

  • Un Mac

  • Un accès à Busuu pour perfectionner ton anglais

  • Des Tech Days tous les 3 mois et un séminaire annuel

  • Des activités sportives et des événements réguliers entre collègues

🌱 Pour t’épanouir chez Pennylane

  • Tu apprécies évoluer dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Tu fais de la collaboration une priorité

  • Tu sais prendre du recul et prioriser les actions à fort impact

  • Tu es à l’aise avec l’idée d’apprendre et d’améliorer continuellement tes pratiques

  • Tu peux travailler en anglais, selon les exigences du poste

Tu ne coches pas toutes les cases ? Postule quand même. Les parcours les plus intéressants ne sont pas toujours linéaires. Ce qui compte, c’est ta trajectoire, ton expertise, ta façon de réfléchir et ton envie de contribuer.

🔒 Information importante à destination des candidats

Les candidatures doivent être envoyées uniquement via nos canaux officiels, notamment notre site carrière et les pages officielles de nos partenaires.

Nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles se terminant par ----- ou ----- style="min-height:1.5em">Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement ni d’informations financières dans le cadre du recrutement. Si une telle demande vous est adressée, ne répondez pas et signalez-la-nous immédiatement.

Pennylane encourage la diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion sous toutes leurs formes. Nous offrons un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux comme à distance.

jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1300 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Contexte du rôle

Pennylane accélère son expansion européenne (France, Allemagne, Espagne) dans un contexte de scale rapide, où la structuration des organisations et la cohérence managériale multi-pays deviennent critiques.
En tant que Head of HRBP (N-1 COMEX), tu construis une fonction HRBP qui est un veritable levier de support à la performance du business : tu influences les décisions d’organisation, sécurises la montée en maturité managériale et aides l’entreprise à passer des caps de transformation.
L’IA est un pilier du rôle : tu anticipes son impact sur les métiers, accompagnes l’adoption et outilles la fonction People pour gagner en efficacité et en prédictibilité.

Missions principales

Ce rôle nécessite des allers-retours fréquents au HQ de Pennylane situé à Paris, chaque semaine, parfois sans nuitée.

Ce rôle nécessite de parler anglais quotidiennement.

Définir et piloter la stratégie HRBP alignée sur les priorités business, les enjeux de scale et l’expansion internationale.

Être le/la partenaire stratégique du COMEX : challenger les orientations d’organisation, éclairer les arbitrages et sécuriser l’exécution.

Anticiper et conduire les transformations organisationnelles (design d’organisation, évolutions de périmètres, montée en compétences managériales).

Construire une approche data-driven et prédictive : KPIs, modèles d’alerte (attrition, engagement, performance, capacité), plans d’action.

Piloter la cohérence People multi-pays : harmoniser là où ça crée de la valeur, tout en respectant les contraintes locales (cadres légaux, culture, pratiques).

Manager, développer et faire évoluer une équipe de 8 HRBPs, en renforçant posture d’influence, priorisation et qualité de delivery.

Structurer la gouvernance HRBP (rituels, operating model, répartition run/projets) et accélérer l’excellence opérationnelle via outils modernes (Workday, agents internes).

Profil recherché

8–12 ans d’expérience RH, avec une expérience d’au moins 3 ans en tant que Head of HRBP / Head of People / DRH dans un environnement déjà très mature ou en forte croissance.

Expérience tangible de construction/structuration d’une fonction HR/HRBP (process, outils, gouvernance, recrutement d’équipe).

Management éprouvé, capacité à piloter une équipe de 8 et à faire évoluer les postures.

Solide business acumen : compréhension des mécaniques de scale, capacité à traduire des priorités business en leviers People concrets.

Très bonne maîtrise des sujets organisation & leadership : org design, performance, talent, engagement, culture, gestion des tensions.

Capacité à naviguer un contexte multi-pays (expérience internationale appréciée, coordination à distance, sensibilité interculturelle).

Forte appétence IA & innovation RH : identification de cas d’usage, cadrage des usages, conduite du changement et montée en compétences.

Excellente capacité d’influence : créer des alliances, challenger avec exigence, tenir une ligne dans la complexité.

Rigueur d’exécution : priorisation, gouvernance, qualité de delivery, capacité à dire non.

Traits personnels clés : esprit bâtisseur, courage managérial, humilité, résilience, sens du collectif.

Processus de recrutement

- 1ère échange avec Thomas (lead Business TA) - 45min

- Entretien avec Marine, VP people (1 h)

- Étude de cas à réaliser chez soi, suivie d’un débriefing avec Marine et Felix, Co-fondateur (1 h)

- Dernier entretien avec les leads People (TA et People Ops) + échange avec les HRBP (30-45 min)

Nous tenons également à souligner que nous adhérons pleinement aux principes de diversité, d’équité et d’inclusion, et que nous mettons tout en œuvre pour créer un environnement sûr et inclusif.
Nous nous engageons à offrir l’égalité des chances en matière d’emploi, sans distinction de genre, d’orientation sexuelle, d’origine, de handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique qui fait de vous ce que vous êtes. Au contraire, la diversité rend notre lieu de travail encore plus agréable.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins enclines à postuler que d’autres si elles ont l’impression de ne pas répondre à l’ensemble des critères.

 

Si vous hésitez, nous vous encourageons à postuler : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d’une collaboration enrichissante et durable.

Que faisons-nous pour faciliter votre vie professionnelle ?

💵 Vous bénéficierez d’une rémunération compétitive

🏡 Vous disposerez d’un budget pour transformer votre domicile en un espace de travail plus confortable, ainsi que d’une allocation mensuelle pour travailler dans un espace de coworking quand vous le souhaitez

⛹️ Grâce à notre partenaire Gymlib, vous aurez accès à 8 000 salles de sport en Europe et à plus de 300 activités liées au bien-être

Si vous êtes basé en France, vous bénéficierez d’un contrat de travail français conforme à la réglementation française, en plus des avantages suivants : 6 à 12 jours de RTT, 5 semaines de congés payés, des crédits repas (Swile), une couverture santé Alan Blue et des événements réguliers dans les villes où les Pennylaners sont les plus nombreux (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

 

Nous travaillons à étendre ces derniers avantages à nos collaborateurs basés hors de France, mais cela peut s’avérer plus complexe selon les pays.

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) We are reinventing how companies manage their finances — and that means striving for operational excellence and transforming our internal processes. Our People team is at the heart of this ambition: we build the systems, tools, and frameworks that allow Pennylane to scale with rigor, fairness, and data-driven clarity.

 

In 6+ years of existence, we’ve managed to:

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners: we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 million small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 8000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Now we plan to continue to build up our People Ops Team - maybe you are the right person for us?

About Pennylane

At Pennylane, we are reinventing how companies manage their finances — and that means striving for operational excellence and transforming our internal processes. Our People team is at the heart of this ambition: we build the systems, tools, and frameworks that allow Pennylane to scale with rigor, fairness, and data-driven clarity.

The role

We're looking for a confirmed or Senior People Operations Specialist to join a team that moves fast, thinks strategically, and genuinely cares about the employee experience.

You'll be part of a structured yet agile People Operations team, working alongside a Head of People Operations and a People Operations Manager (your direct manager), with 5 specialists each owning a dedicated scope. Your scope will cover Tech and Product on the French market.

In this role, your solid grounding in HR operations and your ability to build robust reporting frameworks and automate administrative processes will be essential levers to support Pennylane's continued growth.

What you'll own

People operations partnering & employee lifecycle

  • Be the go-to HR contact for ~300 employees across Tech and Product based in France

  • Own the full employee journey: onboarding, offboarding, contracts, amendments, certificates, absences, end to end and with a high standard of quality

  • Build trusted relationships with employees and managers, and be genuinely responsive and helpful

Payroll & benefits

  • Prepare and transmit payroll variables with precision and reliability

  • Monitor employee benefits (health insurance, pension, meal vouchers) and ensure employees get the most out of them

Process improvement & automation

  • Spot inefficiencies, build solutions, whether that's a smarter Notion page, a better workflow, or a fully automated process

  • Lead or co-lead the digitalization of HR tools and contribute to a more scalable PeopleOps infrastructure

Strategic & cross-functional projects

  • Get involved in projects that go beyond your daily scope: D&I initiatives, EVP, HR tool rollouts

  • Bring structure, documentation, and operational rigor to everything you touch

 

Compliance & regulatory monitoring

  • Stay on top of French labor law and ensure the company remains compliant

  • Keep operational documentation sharp and up to date (onboarding booklet, Notion pages, charters, guides)

 

Why this role is different

  • Real ownership: you're not executing someone else's plan, you define how PeopleOps works for your scope

  • High-impact population: Tech and Product are at the heart of Pennylane's growth

  • Room to grow: as the company scales, so does your scope and influence

  • A team that values craft: we care about doing HR well, not just doing HR fast

⭐ Your profile

 

Experience & expertise: You bring solid experience as a People Ops Specialist gained within a fast-growing company or startup environment.

 

Autonomy & priority management: You are comfortable working independently, with a proven ability to juggle multiple priorities and stay effective in a fast-paced, ever-changing context.

 

Collaboration: You will partner closely on a daily basis with several HRBPs, working hand in hand to support your scope of responsibilities.

 

Growth mindset: Pennylane is a company in full scale-up mode: a lot has already been built, but even more lies ahead. You thrive in environments where things move fast and where embracing change is part of the job.

 

HRIS expertise: You're proficient in Workday and genuinely curious about how AI & automation can make People Ops smarter, you've already started putting that curiosity into practice !

 

Language skills: You are fully fluent in French and proficient in English.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

jobs.title: Solution Architect IA – Expansion Europe (H/F)
jobs.description:
À propos d'ILLUIN Technology


ILLUIN Technology est le leader français de l'IA Générative souveraine et de confiance. Nous développons des modèles de langage (LLM) propriétaires et une plateforme technologique de pointe pour permettre aux entreprises et aux organisations de déployer l'IA générative en toute sécurité, en gardant la maîtrise de leurs données.
Dans un contexte de forte croissance et d'accélération de notre développement international — notamment sur le marché allemand —, nous renforçons notre équipe d'Architectes de Solutions (Solution Architects) pour accompagner nos clients stratégiques européens dans l'adoption de ces technologies transformatrices.


Votre Mission

En tant qu'Architecte de Solutions IA – Europe (Avant-Vente), vous êtes le partenaire technique stratégique de l'équipe commerciale et le pilote technique de notre expansion sur le marché Allemand.
Votre mission est de concevoir des solutions innovantes et robustes basées sur la plateforme et les modèles d'ILLUIN, en réponse aux défis métier complexes de nos grands comptes européens. Vous êtes le garant de la faisabilité technique de la solution proposée et le pivot de la confiance entre les besoins des clients internationaux et la puissance de nos produits.

Responsabilités Clés

Votre rôle s'articule autour de 4 axes principaux :

🚀 Pilotage Technique de l'Avant-Vente & Développement International

  • Discovery & Qualification : Animer des ateliers techniques en France et en Allemagne avec les prospects (DSI, architectes, Data Scientists) pour comprendre en profondeur leurs cas d'usage, leurs contraintes (métier, sécurité, infrastructure) et leurs objectifs.

  • Conception de solution : Concevoir et chiffrer des architectures de solution sur mesure (Cloud, on-premise, hybride) qui intègrent nos produits d'IA Générative (LLM, RAG, agents, etc.).

  • Démonstration & PoC : Préparer et réaliser des démonstrations produits percutantes et adaptées aux spécificités des marchés cibles. Suivre la réalisation de Proof of Concept (PoC) pour prouver la valeur et la performance de nos solutions dans l'environnement du client.

🤝 Soutien au Cycle de Vente International

  • Partenariat commercial : Travailler main dans la main avec les Account Executives (France & Allemagne). Intervenir en véritable "partner" durant le cycle de vente et adapter la stratégie technique aux cultures d'affaires locales.

  • Réponse aux Appels d'Offres (RFI/RFP) : Piloter la rédaction des volets techniques, fonctionnels et architecturaux des réponses (en anglais et en allemand), en mettant en valeur nos différenciateurs (souveraineté européenne, performance, confiance).

  • Soutenance & Closing : Participer activement aux soutenances clients à l'international pour défendre la proposition de valeur technique, lever les objections et rassurer les décisionnaires (DSI, RSSI, Directeurs Métier).

🌉 Interface R&D et Produit

  • Feedback Marché Européen : Capturer et synthétiser les retours terrain (notamment les exigences spécifiques du marché allemand en matière de sécurité et de conformité) pour nourrir la roadmap produit et R&D.

  • Passation : Assurer un transfert de connaissances fluide aux équipes de Delivery (CSM, Professional Services, Direction de Projet) après la signature du contrat.

💡 Veille & Évangélisation

  1. Expertise : Maintenir une veille technologique de pointe sur l'écosystème de l'IA Générative.

  2. Représentation Européenne : Agir en tant qu'expert technique d'ILLUIN lors d'événements majeurs, salons professionnels (notamment en Allemagne) et webinaires.


Profil Recherché

Compétences Techniques (Hard Skills)


• Formation : Bac+5 minimum (Grande École d'Ingénieurs) en Informatique, Data Science, ou domaine connexe.
• Expérience : 5 ans d'expérience minimum dans un rôle technique en contact client (Solution Architect, Ingénieur Avant-Vente, Consultant IA/Data senior, Tech Lead).
• Expertise IA Indispensable :
Excellente maîtrise des concepts de l'IA et du Machine Learning (ML).
Connaissance approfondie de l'écosystème IA Générative : LLM (principes, fine-tuning), RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), pipelines de données, bases de données vectorielles (Vector DBs).
Maîtrise de l'écosystème MLOps et des outils associés.
• Architecture & Infra :
Solides compétences en architecture logicielle et intégration de systèmes (API, microservices).
Maîtrise des environnements Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) ET On-Premise (Kubernetes, Docker, virtualisation).
• Sécurité & Souveraineté : Maîtrise des enjeux de sécurité des données, de la réglementation européenne (RGPD, AI Act) et des exigences de souveraineté numérique (SecNumCloud, C5 en Allemagne, etc.).
• Programmation : Maîtrise de Python et des principales librairies data/IA (Pandas, Scikit-learn, LangChain, Transformers, etc.).


Langues & Mobilité

  1. 🇩🇪 Allemand : Bilingue ou niveau langue maternelle (indispensable pour mener des ateliers techniques et négociations avec le marché allemand).

  2. 🇫🇷 Français : Bilingue / Langue maternelle (indispensable au quotidien pour le business et la technique).

  3. 🇬🇧Anglais : Courant / Fluent (indispensable pour le business et la technique).

✈️ Mobilité : Poste basé en France (siège social) avec des déplacements fréquents à prévoir en Europe, principalement en Allemagne (environ 20% à 30% du temps).


Compétences Comportementales (Soft Skills)

Intelligence Culturelle & Pédagogie : Capacité à adapter votre communication et votre posture aux codes d'affaires germaniques et internationaux, tout en vulgarisant des concepts complexes.

  • Sens Client & Fibre Commerciale : Capacité à déceler les enjeux business derrière la demande technique, à écouter, questionner et convaincre des interlocuteurs C-Level.

  • Problem-Solver & Autonomie : Esprit créatif, orienté solution, capable de gérer plusieurs opportunités internationales en parallèle.

Informations Pratiques & Avantages

  • Localisation : Poste basé sur notre site en France (Paris/Île-de-France) avec télétravail flexible.

  • Déplacements : Fréquents en Europe (principalement Allemagne).

Pourquoi rejoindre ILLUIN Technology ?

  • Le Projet : Travailler sur les technologies les plus avancées (IA Générative) au sein du champion souverain européen de demain.

  • Pionnier du Marché Allemand : Être au cœur de la stratégie d'expansion internationale et jouer un rôle clé dans la conquête du marché allemand.

  • L'Impact : Déployer des architectures d'IA critiques et sécurisées chez les plus grands acteurs industriels et économiques européens.

  • L'Équipe : Rejoindre une structure en hyper-croissance, dynamique, stimulante et multiculturelle.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer with deep expertise in low-level platform bring-up and RT-OS tailoring for embedded real-time applications. You will own the full software stack from bootloader, BSP, OS, and application. You will establish and maintain the toolchain and CI infrastructure that underpins our embedded platforms development.

You are comfortable owning the entire platform software stack independently. You have brought up a (safety critical) MCU from scratch, debugged obscure failures with a debug probe (e.g. JTAG), serial console, logic analyser, or oscilloscope. You instinctively collaborate closely with the hardware team on the platform design and with the application stakeholders on requirements.

Key Responsibilities

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, your role and responsibilities will continuously evolve. Your initial duties include to:

  1. Bring-up the RTOS and develop the BSP for ARM Cortex-M cores, including MPU configuration and inter-core communication

  2. Develop, test and maintain an extensive set of MCU drivers to fulfill application's needs (ADC, SPI, Clock and more)

  3. Develop complete communication stack, validate its integration in host system

  4. Develop drivers for complex ICs

  5. Integration test MCU and FPGA interfaces

  6. Set-up toolchain and CI for the MCU and wider embedded platform (HiL, automated test equipment control...)

  7. Own design documentation and validate requirements

  8. Coordinate with all disciplines working on a unit (electronics design engineers, system engineers, test team, EGSE team)

  9. Continuous learning: stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in avionics design

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Senior Embedded Software Developer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field

  • Strong background in embedded C / C++ coding

  • RTOS bring-up experience on Cortex-M cores (ThreadX / Azure RTOS, FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or equivalent)

  • Hands-on experience in firmware development and platform bring-up

  • Hands-on experience in various communication protocols/stacks (SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet IP/TCP).

  • Knowledge of safety-critical design principles

  • Familiarity with Reliability, Availability, Maintainability & Safety (RAMS) aspects

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams (hardware engineers, test engineers, EGSE engineers, etc.)

  • Meticulous attention to detail in design, analysis, and documentation

  • Hands on mentality at testing and problem debugging in laboratory

  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for embedded hardware targets is a plus

  • Experience with TSN is a plus

  • Experience with FPGA and VHDL language is a plus

  • Experience with python and bash is a plus

  • Understanding of space relevant standards (like ECSS, MIL-STD, NASA-HBK) and regulations is a plus

  • Awareness of functional safety standards (ISO 26262, DO-178C, or similar) and their implications for the software stack is a plus

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

jobs.title: Field CTO, DACH
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The role

The Field CTO role is one of Mistral's senior external technical voices; a role for someone who has earned genuine credibility in the AI field and can engage enterprise boards, CIOs, and CTOs as a peer. You will shape how strategic accounts think about their AI strategy, represent Mistral at major industry events, and publish thought leadership that reflects a real point of view on where AI is going.

You will work closely with regional sales leadership across your territory and bring what you learn from executive conversations back into Mistral's product direction. This is an externally-facing, influence-driven role. The output is measured in relationships built, content published, and executive conversations that move.

What You Will Do

Executive engagement

Run Mistral's Executive Briefing Center with your regional VP; a selective program for C-level stakeholders at strategic accounts. Build and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VP Engineering across your territory.

Thought leadership

Publish regularly: articles, whitepapers, and analysis of where enterprise AI is heading. Brief Gartner and Forrester on Mistral's roadmap and market position. Track frontier research and bring it into customer conversations.

Conference and event presence

Represent Mistral at major industry events through keynotes, panels, and roundtables. Build a public presence that generates inbound interest from enterprise executives and the wider AI community.

Market feedback

Bring what you hear in executive conversations back into product direction. Patterns across accounts on governance requirements and deployment constraints should reach the people building the models.

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrable credibility in the AI field. A public track record in AI: published papers, articles, or talks that reflect a clear, defensible position. Your work should read as credible next to Mistral's technical brand.

  • A stated position on open-weight models and what they change for the enterprises adopting them. Your existing public positions should sit comfortable next to Mistral's.

  • You are fluent in European data sovereignty and on-premise deployment, at the level that holds up with a CTO or VP Engineering asking hard questions.

  • You are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders across multiple verticals on technical architecture and business strategy, in the same conversation.

  • Cross-vertical fluency, you can credibly engage across financial services, manufacturing, defense, and energy without being a domain specialist in any one of them.

  • 10–25 years of experience in enterprise technology. You have held roles such as: Field CTO, Principal Architect, or VP Engineering at a major cloud or AI company, or a founder who built technical credibility and executive relationships through their own company.

  • Comfortable with 30-50% travel depending on your region.

Nice to have

  • Existing network of CTO and CIO relationships at enterprise accounts in your region

  • Prior Field CTO or equivalent externally facing technical role at a major cloud or AI company

  • Fluent in multiple languages spoken across your region

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Support Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

You'll be joining Primer's Product Support team, reporting to our Support Lead. Support here isn't a cost centre bolted onto the side of the business — it sits inside Engineering as a full discipline, working alongside the developers who ship Primer's platform. Primer's customers are payments-technical merchants and partners, so the team spends its time in APIs, SDKs, and integration logs as much as in a ticket queue.

The team runs 24/7 across Asia, Europe, and North America, and has grown to the point where one manager can no longer run it alone — which is why this role exists. You and our Support Lead will co-own Support's KPIs, metrics, and processes day-to-day. We run a deliberately low-ego, high-trust team — no dictated training plans, no micromanagement. You're joining at a genuinely interesting moment: due to the team's strong results and delivery on all our KPIs (especially Escalation Ratio and CSAT of 4.8/5), the team is about to expand into new territory as we expand the functions, partners and merchants that we support, so there's real room to shape where we go next.

What will you be doing?

  • Co-own Support's day-to-day KPIs, metrics, and processes, with direct accountability for your own group of Support Engineers. Step in when others are not available.

  • Manage and coach a growing team of 5 Support Engineers spanning Asia, Europe, and the Americas — their delivery, growth, and performance.

  • Drive operational excellence. Hold the team to a consistent bar on quality and pace. Perform QA, and review proposals and RFCs.

  • Stay technically credible — dig into APIs, SDKs, and logs yourself, and step in to cover the team during periods of high demand, and on escalations.

  • Own triage, escalation, and incident processes for your team, including leading and communicating through severe incidents and their post-mortems.

  • Hold the team to a consistent quality and pace bar — review work, and coach rather than just monitor.

  • Partner directly with Product and Engineering leadership to surface recurring issues, shape a realistic roadmap, and represent the voice of the customer.

  • Identify knowledge and skill gaps across the team and facilitate the training to close them.

  • Report on support performance and initiatives to Product & Engineering leadership, with real visibility across the company.

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years managing people, running a 24/7, distributed support operation — this is the one piece of experience that's essential for us

  • Technical enough to still debug an API integration or work through logs yourself, not just manage people who do.

  • A steady, consistent operator — someone reliable day in day out, not just on their best days.

  • Strong written and verbal communicator, comfortable presenting to the wider company.

  • Experience managing a major incident through to a post-mortem and RCA.

  • Familiarity with ticketing systems like Jira, JSM, or Zendesk, and with ITSM and reporting/BI solutions.

Nice-to-haves:

  • 1-2 years in payments, or a strong B2B/SaaS background as a substitute.

You may not like it here

  • Support here isn't always exciting — you're managing people who spend their day in a ticket queue, looking at issues, troubleshooting and investigating. Time is of the essence.

  • You'll be expected to still do the job yourself when it's busy — reviewing logs, digging into an API issue, especially on escalations or incidents — not just delegate and report up.

  • Consistency is graded harder here than almost anywhere else.

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

💰 Competitive share options
🌴 Uncapped holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken
🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities

💻 The best equipment for your role
🏠 £500 towards your home office setup
🔎 Generous learning budget
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits (depending on location)

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At Primer, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.description:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About the role

We're hiring our first Demand Generation Lead for EMEA, Middle East and Emerging Markets. You'll own how LangSmith shows up in the region and how that turns into pipeline from partnering with performance marketing, lifecycle marketing, integrated campaigns and webinars to build a localized campaigns.

You'll be deciding what works in the region, run the experiments to prove it, and then scale what works into a repeatable regional playbook. You’ll be a builder with central support from our US demand gen, product marketing, and marketing ops teams.

Location: London or Amsterdam (one of our EMEA office hubs).

What you'll own

Regional demand strategy and pipeline

  • Build the EMEA demand plan: which markets, which segments, which channels, and what each is expected to return

  • Own an EMEA pipeline target and report against it sourced and influenced, by channel and by market

  • Decide how the regional demand budget gets allocated for localized programs.

Full-funnel program execution

You'll own the whole mix for the region and be hands-on in all of it:

  • Paid digital: partner with performance marketing to support localized 3rd party promotion, paid search, paid social, and retargeting strategy, including account-level and contact-level targeting to give sellers air cover in named accounts

  • Webinars: run a regional cadence across live demos, thought leadership webinars, technical workshops, and customer stories, in local time zones with local speakers where it helps

  • Integrated campaigns: adapt global LangSmith narratives and build region-first campaigns when the market needs something different

  • Lifecycle: build segmented nurtures and post-event follow-up for regional leads, with attention to language and time zone.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Work directly with EMEA AEs and SDRs to understand what converts in-region and co-design follow-up plays that drive pipeline.

  • Partner closely with Field Marketing to build joint regional plans, align priorities, and create a coordinated interface into the sales team.

  • Support new-hire ramp by identifying warm signals, share campaign hand-off details, marketing programs, and proven outreach plays reps can use in their first 90 days.

  • Collaborate with RevOps on targeting, routing, campaign tracking, and reporting to improve regional execution and pipeline visibility.

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years in B2B demand generation, growth marketing, or integrated campaigns, ideally in developer tools, infrastructure, or technical SaaS

  • Track record of building demand programs in EMEA across multiple countries, with a clear view of where localization matters and where it doesn't

  • You've personally run paid, webinars, lifecycle, and ABM

  • You write the copy, build the landing page, pull the report, and launch the campaign

  • Comfortable with a technical product and a technical audience. You don't need to write code, but you should be able to hold a conversation about agents, evals, and observability without a script

  • Strong partner to Sales. You've worked shoulder to shoulder with AEs and SDRs and you're comfortable with a pipeline number

  • Fluent in the numbers: funnel conversion, CPL, cost per SQO, pipeline contribution, and attribution's real limits

  • Working command of a modern stack, Hubspot, Influ2, Qualified, Goldcast, Zoom Webinar, Zapier, SFDC, Reo.dev, and Clay

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and true ownership

  • Salary Range: 95,000 GPB - 125,000 GBP + Equity

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. Actual compensation and offerings will vary based on role, level, and location. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

Lead Support & QA Engineer (F/H)
jobs.description:
Acteur majeur de l'IA Générative en France et en Europe, ILLUIN Technology conçoit des solutions sur-mesure et des produits propriétaires (ILLUIN Dialogue, Doc Automation, Analyze) déployés chez de grands comptes aux exigences élevées.

Soutenus par un investissement stratégique de 25 millions d'euros mené par Seven2, nous traversons une phase de structuration forte. Notre équipe compte aujourd'hui plus de 170 collaborateurs. Nous attachons une importance particulière à maintenir un niveau d'excellence technique tout en préservant un environnement de travail sain et exigeant (classé 1er au label HappyIndex®AtWork).

Le contexte et l'enjeu du poste

Avec l'augmentation du nombre de clients et l'évolution rapide de nos produits, nous devons renforcer notre organisation opérationnelle.

Nous créons le rôle de Lead Support & QA Engineer avec un double objectif :

  1. Assurer un suivi irréprochable des sollicitations clients et rationaliser les flux d'escalade vers les équipes de développement.

  2. Élever le niveau d'exigence sur la qualité avant les mises en production.

Vos missions

1. Support client & Qualification technique

  • Traiter, qualifier et diagnostiquer les demandes et incidents remontés par nos clients B2B (Niveau 1 & 2).

  • Utiliser les outils de suivi et d'observabilité pour isoler la cause d'un problème (erreurs API, logs, configurations).

  • Assurer la communication avec les clients pour les tenir informés de l'avancement de leurs tickets.

2. Orchestration & Coordination

  • Suivre le cycle de vie des tickets complexes et organiser le passage vers les équipes de développement (Niveau 2/3) lorsque cela est nécessaire.

  • Veiller à ce que les équipes techniques ne soient sollicitées que sur des sujets qualifiés et documentés.

  • Améliorer les processus de ticketing internes (automatisation, workflows, règles d'escalade).

3. Assurance Qualité (QA)

  • Exécuter des campagnes de tests fonctionnels et de recette sur nos environnements de pré-production avant chaque livraison majeur ou mise à jour.

  • Identifier les régressions, remonter les bugs de façon précise et suivre leur correction.

  • Participer progressivement à la définition des stratégies de test applicatif.

4. Capitalisation & Retour d'expérience

  • Alimenter et maintenir la base de connaissances interne ainsi que la documentation produit destinée aux clients.

  • Identifier les problèmes récurrents pour remonter du feedback structuré aux équipes Produit.

Votre profil

Ce que nous recherchons avant tout

  • Expérience : 2 à 5 ans d'expérience sur un poste de Support Technique (L2/L3), d'Ingénieur QA ou de Support Applicatif, idéalement au sein d'un éditeur de logiciels SaaS ou d'une entreprise tech.

  • Aisance technique : Vous savez inspecter une requête via l'outil développeur du navigateur, lire des données structurées (JSON), interroger une API REST et naviguer dans des outils de monitoring (Datadog, Sentry, etc.).

  • Maîtrise des outils de support : Vous avez une bonne pratique de Jira Service Management (JSM) ou d'un outil équivalent, et vous savez y configurer des workflows simples.

  • Communication : Vous faites preuve de pédagogie et de rigueur rédactionnelle, aussi bien face à un client B2B qu'auprès des équipes de dev.

Un plus pour votre candidature

  • Des connaissances en scripting ou programmation (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript).

  • Une première approche des outils d'automatisation de test (Playwright, Cypress) ou d'outils d'IA (LLMs, RAG).

  • Une première expérience d'encadrement ou d'animation d'une petite équipe support/QA.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un rôle pivot dans une entreprise tech en forte croissance, avec un réel impact sur la satisfaction client et la qualité produit.

  • L'opportunité de monter en compétences sur des produits IA de pointe.

  • Un cadre de travail stimulant.
